entries.shortAnswer: 「甜」的英文是 sweet，如 This cake is too sweet。注意 sweet 也可形容人「贴心」，但说食物「甜」不能用 sweetish（微甜）或 sugary（含糖多）。
entries.definition: 甜在英语中通常说 sweet，指蛋糕、水果的甜味。sweet 还可形容人「温柔体贴」或「可爱」，如 a sweet girl。描述口味时，sweet 为五味词之一；想说「有点甜」用 a bit sweet，说「太甜」用 too sweet。

examples.en: This mango is very sweet, so I'll add some lemon juice to balance it.
examples.zh: 这个芒果很甜，所以我加了些柠檬汁来平衡味道。

examples.en: She has a sweet smile that makes everyone feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她笑起来很甜，让每个人都感到亲切。

entries.shortAnswer: sweet 的中文意思是「甜」，如 The tea is sweet。它还可形容人「贴心、可爱」，但表达「甜味」时不用 sugary（含糖多）或 sweetish（微甜）。
entries.definition: sweet 的核心词义是「有甜味的」，如 sweet fruit 甜水果。口语中可形容人「善良、温柔」，如 a sweet smile。注意区分：sweet 是味道甜，sugary 强调多糖，sweetish 指微甜。

examples.en: This mango is very sweet, so I'll add some lemon juice to balance it.
examples.zh: 这个芒果很甜，所以我加了些柠檬汁来平衡味道。

examples.en: She has a sweet smile that makes everyone feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她笑起来很甜，让每个人都感到亲切。

entries.shortAnswer: 「咸」的英文是 salty，指食物含盐分多、味道重。注意 salty 通常带贬义，说「咸淡适中」要用 well-seasoned 或 just right，别直接说 not salty。
entries.definition: salty 主要形容食物盐味重，如 salty soup、too salty；也可形容人「爱记仇、容易炸毛」的口语义。问咸淡常用 How salty is it?；「有点咸」是 a bit salty，「太咸了」是 way too salty。

examples.en: This soup is way too salty—did you add salt twice?
examples.zh: 这汤太咸了，你是不是放了两次盐？

examples.en: He's still salty about losing the game last week.
examples.zh: 他还在为上周输掉比赛而耿耿于怀。

entries.shortAnswer: salty 的中文意思是「咸」，形容食物盐放多了、味道偏重。和中文「咸」不同，salty 在口语里还常指人「爱记仇、动不动就炸」，这是中文「咸」没有的引申义。
entries.definition: salty 是五味词之一，常搭配 salty food、salty soup、taste salty；口语中形容人 bitter/salty 表示因小事耿耿于怀。日常说「咸淡正好」用 perfectly seasoned，别用 not salty。

examples.en: This soup is way too salty—did you add salt twice?
examples.zh: 这汤太咸了，你是不是放了两次盐？

examples.en: He's still salty about losing the game last week.
examples.zh: 他还在为上周输掉比赛而耿耿于怀。

entries.shortAnswer: 「油腻」的英文是 greasy，形容食物含油多、口感肥腻。注意 greasy 多带贬义，指油得让人不舒服；若只是「油润适中」，用 oily 或 rich 更中性。
entries.definition: greasy 常搭配 greasy food、greasy pizza、greasy spoon（廉价小餐馆）。口语里也说 It's too greasy. 表示太油了。辨析：greasy 强调表面或口感油滑发腻，多贬义；oily 偏中性，可指含油；rich 指味道浓郁厚重。

examples.en: The fried chicken was so greasy that my fingers were covered in oil.
examples.zh: 炸鸡太油腻了，我手指上全是油。

examples.en: I don't like greasy food; I prefer something light and refreshing.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢油腻的食物，更偏爱清淡爽口的。

entries.shortAnswer: greasy 的中文意思是「油腻」，形容食物油多、吃起来肥腻。它通常带贬义，指油得让人不舒服；比 oily 更强调「腻」的口感，而 oily 偏中性。
entries.definition: greasy 形容食物表面或口感油滑发腻，如 greasy chips、greasy burger。口语常用 too greasy 抱怨太油。注意与 oily 区别：oily 中性，可指含油；greasy 多贬义，暗示不健康或不清爽。

examples.en: The fried chicken was so greasy that my fingers were covered in oil.
examples.zh: 炸鸡太油腻了，我手指上全是油。

examples.en: I don't like greasy food; I prefer something light and refreshing.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢油腻的食物，更偏爱清淡爽口的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「苦」的英文是 bitter，指黑咖啡、苦瓜那种令人皱眉的味道。注意 bitter 还可指「怨恨的」，如 bitter about the past。
entries.definition: 形容词，指味觉的苦：bitter coffee（苦咖啡）、bitter melon（苦瓜）。引申指愤懑、苦涩，如 a bitter argument。中文「辛苦」不用 bitter，用 hard。

examples.en: This black coffee is too bitter for me; I need some sugar.
examples.zh: 这杯黑咖啡对我来说太苦了，我需要加点糖。

examples.en: Bitter melon tastes bitter at first, but it has a refreshing aftertaste.
examples.zh: 苦瓜刚入口时是苦的，但回味很清爽。

entries.shortAnswer: bitter 的中文意思是「苦」，指像黑咖啡、苦瓜那样令人皱眉的味觉，与 sour（酸）、salty（咸）并列。也可引申为「愤懑的」。
entries.definition: 形容词，表味觉的苦：bitter coffee、bitter melon。引申为愤懑、痛苦，如 bitter disappointment。名词指英式苦啤，a pint of bitter。勿与 sour（酸）混用。

examples.en: This black coffee is too bitter for me; I need some sugar.
examples.zh: 这杯黑咖啡对我来说太苦了，我需要加点糖。

examples.en: Bitter melon tastes bitter at first, but it has a refreshing aftertaste.
examples.zh: 苦瓜刚入口时是苦的，但回味很清爽。

entries.shortAnswer: 「饱」的英文是 full，表示吃饱了。最关键的辨析是：full 指已经吃饱，若想说吃得太撑，英语常用 stuffed。
entries.definition: full 作形容词表示吃饱的，常用搭配有 I'm full（我吃饱了）、feel full（觉得饱）。注意 full 是状态词，不表示正在吃；吃撑了用 stuffed 更贴切。

examples.en: No thanks, I'm full. I couldn't eat another bite.
examples.zh: 不了，谢谢，我吃饱了，一口也吃不下了。

examples.en: The kids were so full after dinner that they fell asleep on the couch.
examples.zh: 孩子们晚饭吃得太饱，直接在沙发上睡着了。

entries.shortAnswer: full 的中文意思是「饱」，指已经吃饱的状态。它与 stuffed 的关键区别是：full 表示吃饱，stuffed 表示吃得太撑。
entries.definition: full 形容吃饱的，口语常说 I'm full 或 I feel full，礼貌谢绝加菜时也用。注意不要用 full 表示吃撑，那种感觉用 stuffed；full 还可指容器装满。

examples.en: No thanks, I'm full. I couldn't eat another bite.
examples.zh: 不了，谢谢，我吃饱了，一口也吃不下了。

examples.en: The kids were so full after dinner that they fell asleep on the couch.
examples.zh: 孩子们晚饭吃得太饱，直接在沙发上睡着了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「剩饭」最常用英语 leftovers，指吃剩的饭菜；注意不要用 leftover rice 表达所有剩饭，它特指剩米饭。
entries.definition: leftovers 恒为复数，搭配 eat/finish/reheat leftovers、leftovers from dinner；可指餐厅打包菜，也可指冰箱存货。leftover 作形容词时意为剩余的。

examples.en: We had leftovers from dinner last night, so I just heated them up for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚晚饭剩了菜，所以我中午热了热就吃了。

examples.en: Don't throw away the leftovers—they'll go well with rice tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别把剩饭扔了，明天用来下饭正好。

entries.shortAnswer: leftovers 中文常译「剩饭」，指吃剩的饭菜；与 leftover 不同，leftovers 是名词复数，leftover 多作形容词。
entries.definition: leftovers 指饭后剩下的食物，口语常用，搭配 eat/heat up/finish leftovers。可表示餐厅打包食物或冰箱里的存货，不是指剩米饭。

examples.en: We had leftovers from dinner last night, so I just heated them up for lunch.
examples.zh: 我们昨晚晚饭剩了菜，所以我中午热了热就吃了。

examples.en: Don't throw away the leftovers—they'll go well with rice tomorrow.
examples.zh: 别把剩饭扔了，明天用来下饭正好。

entries.shortAnswer: 「小菜」最常说的英文是 side dish，指搭配主菜的小份菜；但中式「小菜」也常指开胃腌菜 pickles 或凉拌小菜 appetizer，别一律译成 vegetable。
entries.definition: 作「配菜」时用 side dish，如 a side dish of pickles；作早餐清粥小菜里的「咸菜、酱菜」时常用 pickles 或 pickled vegetables。口语也可说 side，如 fries as a side。

examples.en: This pickled cucumber is a great side dish for rice because it goes well with rice.
examples.zh: 这道腌黄瓜是很棒的下饭小菜，因为它很下饭。

examples.en: We ordered grilled fish with two side dishes: a light flavor salad and some pickles.
examples.zh: 我们点了烤鱼和两道小菜：一份清淡的沙拉和一些腌菜。

entries.shortAnswer: side dish 的中文意思是「小菜」，指与主菜一起上桌的配菜；它不等于 appetizer（开胃菜），side dish 通常随主菜同吃，分量较小。
entries.definition: side dish 是可数名词，常见搭配 a side dish of…、as a side dish、side dishes。餐厅点餐时也可简说 side，如 choice of side。多指配菜，不指主菜，也不一定都是蔬菜。

examples.en: This pickled cucumber is a great side dish for rice because it goes well with rice.
examples.zh: 这道腌黄瓜是很棒的下饭小菜，因为它很下饭。

examples.en: We ordered grilled fish with two side dishes: a light flavor salad and some pickles.
examples.zh: 我们点了烤鱼和两道小菜：一份清淡的沙拉和一些腌菜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「清淡」的英文是 light flavor，形容食物味道柔和、不油不咸不辣不重。
entries.definition: light flavor 指食物口味清淡、调味不重，常用于汤、蒸菜、粥。口语也说 mild 或 not too heavy。

examples.en: This steamed fish has a light flavor, so it goes well with rice.
examples.zh: 这道清蒸鱼口味清淡，所以很下饭。

examples.en: I prefer a light flavor when I'm not feeling well, like plain congee or clear soup.
examples.zh: 我不舒服的时候更喜欢清淡的口味，比如白粥或清汤。

entries.shortAnswer: light flavor 的中文意思是「清淡」，指食物味道柔和、不油腻、不咸不辣、调味不重。
entries.definition: light flavor 指清淡口味，常见搭配 a light flavor、light flavor profile，用于汤、蒸菜、粥。

examples.en: This steamed fish has a light flavor, so it goes well with rice.
examples.zh: 这道清蒸鱼口味清淡，所以很下饭。

examples.en: I prefer a light flavor when I'm not feeling well, like plain congee or clear soup.
examples.zh: 我不舒服的时候更喜欢清淡的口味，比如白粥或清汤。

entries.shortAnswer: 「大排档」的英文是 open-air food stall。特指街头露天、现炒现卖、价格亲民、烟火气浓的夜宵摊档，正式餐馆不用这个词。
entries.definition: 常搭配 open-air food stall 表示路边露天排档，香港粤语借词作 dai pai dong。核心是便宜热闹、坐在路边吃夜宵，与正规餐厅 restaurant 不同。

examples.en: We grabbed late-night noodles at an open-air food stall near the night market.
examples.zh: 我们在夜市附近的露天大排档吃了宵夜面条。

examples.en: The open-air food stalls are always packed with people looking for cheap and tasty dishes.
examples.zh: 大排档总是挤满了寻找便宜又好吃菜肴的人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「open-air food stall」的中文意思是「大排档」。指街头露天、便宜热闹、现做现吃的摊档，不是正式餐馆。
entries.definition: open-air food stall 指路边露天排档，常见于夜市和街头，也可用粤语借词 dai pai dong。口语中强调便宜、烟火气和夜宵，正式场合少用。

examples.en: We grabbed late-night noodles at an open-air food stall near the night market.
examples.zh: 我们在夜市附近的露天大排档吃了宵夜面条。

examples.en: The open-air food stalls are always packed with people looking for cheap and tasty dishes.
examples.zh: 大排档总是挤满了寻找便宜又好吃菜肴的人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「酸」的英文是 sour，指醋、柠檬那种酸味。注意 sour 常带“发酸、变馊”的负面意味，说食物变质常用 go sour。
entries.definition: sour 作形容词覆盖五味中的酸；搭配有 sour taste、sour and sweet（酸甜）。说“有点酸”用 a bit sour；食物变馊则说 The milk went sour。若强调开胃的酸，可用 tart 或 tangy，避免误用 sour 让人联想到坏掉。

examples.en: This green apple is too sour for me; I prefer something sweeter.
examples.zh: 这个青苹果对我来说太酸了，我更喜欢吃甜一点的。

examples.en: The milk has gone sour, so don't drink it.
examples.zh: 牛奶已经变酸了，别喝了。

entries.shortAnswer: sour 的中文意思是「酸」，指像柠檬、醋那样的味道。与 bitter（苦）不同，sour 是五味之一，也可引申为“变馊、发酸”。
entries.definition: sour 作形容词指酸味，常见搭配 sour taste、sweet and sour、go sour（变馊、变坏）。口语中 a sour face 指脸色难看。注意它多含负面意味，描述水果的天然酸味可用 tart 或 tangy 更贴切。

examples.en: This green apple is too sour for me; I prefer something sweeter.
examples.zh: 这个青苹果对我来说太酸了，我更喜欢吃甜一点的。

examples.en: The milk has gone sour, so don't drink it.
examples.zh: 牛奶已经变酸了，别喝了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「麻」的英文是 numbing spice，指花椒带来的刺痛麻木感，不是 spicy（辣）。「又麻又辣」可说 numbing and spicy，或直接用借词 mala。
entries.definition: numbing spice 指产生麻感的花椒类香料，核心是刺痛麻木而非灼烧辣感。常见搭配：a numbing sensation、numbing and spicy。易错点：麻≠辣，不能只用 spicy 翻译「麻」。

examples.en: This Sichuan hotpot has a strong numbing spice from the Sichuan peppercorns, which makes your lips tingle.
examples.zh: 这个四川火锅有很强的麻感，来自花椒，让你的嘴唇发麻。

examples.en: If you can't handle numbing spice, ask for less Sichuan pepper in the dish.
examples.zh: 如果你受不了麻，就请他们在菜里少放点花椒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「numbing spice」中文意思是「麻」，指花椒引起的刺痛麻木感，不是「辣」(spicy)。常与 spicy 并用：numbing and spicy，或直接用借词 mala。
entries.definition: numbing spice 指产生麻感的花椒类香料，核心是刺痛麻木而非灼烧辣感。常见搭配：numbing and spicy、a numbing sensation。口语也常用借词 mala。易错点：不要用 spicy 单独翻译「麻」。

examples.en: This Sichuan hotpot has a strong numbing spice from the Sichuan peppercorns, which makes your lips tingle.
examples.zh: 这个四川火锅有很强的麻感，来自花椒，让你的嘴唇发麻。

examples.en: If you can't handle numbing spice, ask for less Sichuan pepper in the dish.
examples.zh: 如果你受不了麻，就请他们在菜里少放点花椒。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发物」指生病或伤口恢复期应避开的食物，英文近似说法是 food to avoid when sick，如海鲜、羊肉等。
entries.definition: 发物是中医食忌概念，指易诱发旧疾或加重病情的食物，如海鲜、羊肉、香菜。英文无对应词，常译作 food to avoid when sick。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, seafood is often seen as food to avoid when sick, especially during wound recovery.
examples.zh: 在中医里，海鲜常被视为发物，尤其在伤口恢复期间应避免食用。

examples.en: My grandmother says lamb is food to avoid when sick, so she never cooks it when I have a cold.
examples.zh: 我奶奶说羊肉是发物，所以我感冒时她从不做羊肉。

entries.shortAnswer: food to avoid when sick 近似中医「发物」，指生病或伤口恢复期应避开的食物，如海鲜、羊肉、香菜等。
entries.definition: food to avoid when sick 是中医「发物」的近似说法，并非西医术语，指生病或伤口恢复期可能加重病情的食物，如海鲜、羊肉。

examples.en: In traditional Chinese medicine, seafood is often seen as food to avoid when sick, especially during wound recovery.
examples.zh: 在中医里，海鲜常被视为发物，尤其在伤口恢复期间应避免食用。

examples.en: My grandmother says lamb is food to avoid when sick, so she never cooks it when I have a cold.
examples.zh: 我奶奶说羊肉是发物，所以我感冒时她从不做羊肉。

entries.shortAnswer: 「挑食」的英文是 picky eater，意思是吃东西很挑剔、只肯吃固定几样的人。
entries.definition: picky eater 是名词，常用 be a picky eater 或 be picky about food；比 fussy eater 更日常。

examples.en: My little brother is such a picky eater that he refuses to touch any vegetable.
examples.zh: 我弟弟特别挑食，什么蔬菜都不肯碰。

examples.en: If you're a picky eater, it's hard to enjoy a set menu at a restaurant.
examples.zh: 如果你挑食，在餐厅就很难享受固定套餐。

entries.shortAnswer: A picky eater is someone very fussy about food—the everyday English for「挑食」.
entries.definition: Picky eater is a common noun; use be a picky eater or be picky about food, milder than fussy eater.

examples.en: My little brother is such a picky eater that he refuses to touch any vegetable.
examples.zh: 我弟弟特别挑食，什么蔬菜都不肯碰。

examples.en: If you're a picky eater, it's hard to enjoy a set menu at a restaurant.
examples.zh: 如果你挑食，在餐厅就很难享受固定套餐。

entries.shortAnswer: 「口味」的英文是 flavor preference，指个人对甜酸苦咸等味道的偏好。点餐或聊天时用 flavor preference 最自然，别硬说 taste mouth。
entries.definition: flavor preference 是名词短语，常见搭配有 personal flavor preference、change one's flavor preference。注意「口味」还可指菜系风味（如川菜口味），这时用 flavor 或 cuisine 更合适。

examples.en: My flavor preference leans toward spicy food, so I always add chili oil to my noodles.
examples.zh: 我的口味偏辣，所以吃面时总要加辣椒油。

examples.en: The restaurant lets you choose your flavor preference, from light to extra salty.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅让你选择口味，从清淡到重咸都可以。

entries.shortAnswer: flavor preference 的中文意思是「口味」，指个人对食物味道的喜好倾向。它强调长期偏好，而 taste 多指当下的味觉感受。
entries.definition: flavor preference 常用于餐饮、营养和消费调查语境，如 ask about someone's flavor preference。口语中也可说 taste preference，但 flavor 更侧重甜酸苦咸等具体风味。

examples.en: My flavor preference leans toward spicy food, so I always add chili oil to my noodles.
examples.zh: 我的口味偏辣，所以吃面时总要加辣椒油。

examples.en: The restaurant lets you choose your flavor preference, from light to extra salty.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅让你选择口味，从清淡到重咸都可以。

entries.shortAnswer: 「加菜」在英文里常说 add a dish，意思是在已经点好的菜之外再添一道菜，不是把某道菜加量。
entries.definition: add a dish 多用于点餐、聚餐或请客的场合，如 Let's add a dish 就是「我们再点一道菜吧」。也可说 order one more dish。

examples.en: There are six of us, so let's add a dish or two to the order.
examples.zh: 我们有六个人，所以点餐时再加一两道菜吧。

examples.en: If the table still looks empty, the host will add a dish before the soup is served.
examples.zh: 如果桌上看着还空，主人会在上汤之前再加一道菜。

entries.shortAnswer: add a dish 的中文意思就是「加菜」，指在原有菜品之外再点一道或再做一道菜，而不是加饭或加汤。
entries.definition: add a dish 常用于点餐、聚餐、请客的场合，如 We should add a dish for the guests，强调增添一道菜，而非加大份量。

examples.en: There are six of us, so let's add a dish or two to the order.
examples.zh: 我们有六个人，所以点餐时再加一两道菜吧。

examples.en: If the table still looks empty, the host will add a dish before the soup is served.
examples.zh: 如果桌上看着还空，主人会在上汤之前再加一道菜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拼桌」的英文是 share a table，指和陌生人同桌吃饭，常见于茶餐厅高峰期。
entries.definition: 拼桌常见于网红店、茶餐厅高峰期，英语常说 share a table with strangers；欧美餐厅较少拼桌。

examples.en: We had to share a table with another couple because the restaurant was packed.
examples.zh: 餐厅爆满，我们只好和另一对夫妇拼桌。

examples.en: In many Chinese diners, you may share a table with strangers during rush hour.
examples.zh: 在中国的很多小餐馆，高峰时段你可能要和陌生人拼桌。

entries.shortAnswer: “share a table” means 拼桌, sitting at one table with strangers, common in crowded diners.
entries.definition: To share a table is to sit with strangers at one table, common in China's busy restaurants; in the West it is less common.

examples.en: We had to share a table with another couple because the restaurant was packed.
examples.zh: 餐厅爆满，我们只好和另一对夫妇拼桌。

examples.en: In many Chinese diners, you may share a table with strangers during rush hour.
examples.zh: 在中国的很多小餐馆，高峰时段你可能要和陌生人拼桌。

entries.shortAnswer: 「下饭菜」的英文是 dish that goes with rice。指专门配米饭吃、能让人多扒几口饭的咸香开胃菜，比如麻婆豆腐或咸菜炒肉。
entries.definition: dish that goes with rice 多作可数名词，口语里也说 a good dish to go with rice。注意它强调「配饭」而非「下酒」，下酒菜应说 dish that goes with alcohol 或 bar snack。

examples.en: Mapo tofu is a classic dish that goes with rice, so I always order it when I want to eat more.
examples.zh: 麻婆豆腐是一道经典的下饭菜，所以我想多吃点饭时总会点它。

examples.en: My grandmother made a salty pickled vegetable dish that goes with rice perfectly.
examples.zh: 我奶奶做了一道咸香的腌菜，特别下饭。

entries.shortAnswer: dish that goes with rice 的中文意思是「下饭菜」。指口味咸香、开胃、特别适合搭配白米饭吃的菜，和单纯形容味道的 savory 不同。
entries.definition: dish that goes with rice 用于描述配米饭吃的菜，可数，常说 a dish that goes with rice。它强调「下饭」这个功能，不表示菜本身是主食；若想说「下酒菜」应用 dish that goes with alcohol。

examples.en: Mapo tofu is a classic dish that goes with rice, so I always order it when I want to eat more.
examples.zh: 麻婆豆腐是一道经典的下饭菜，所以我想多吃点饭时总会点它。

examples.en: My grandmother made a salty pickled vegetable dish that goes with rice perfectly.
examples.zh: 我奶奶做了一道咸香的腌菜，特别下饭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「解辣」的英文是 relieve spiciness，指缓解口腔辣感，常搭配 milk、yogurt、sugar，用于吃喝场景。
entries.definition: relieve spiciness 意为缓解辛辣灼烧感，主语多为饮品或食物，如 milk can relieve spiciness；口语也说 cool down your mouth。

examples.en: Drinking a glass of milk can quickly relieve spiciness after eating hot pot.
examples.zh: 吃完火锅后喝一杯牛奶能快速解辣。

examples.en: Some people chew on a piece of sugar to relieve spiciness when the dish is too hot.
examples.zh: 菜太辣时，有些人会嚼一块糖来解辣。

entries.shortAnswer: relieve spiciness 的中文是「解辣」，指缓解吃辣后的灼烧感，常与 milk、yogurt 等搭配，偏口语。
entries.definition: relieve spiciness 指缓解口腔辛辣刺激，常搭配 drink milk to relieve spiciness；正式场合可用 mitigate the burning sensation。

examples.en: Drinking a glass of milk can quickly relieve spiciness after eating hot pot.
examples.zh: 吃完火锅后喝一杯牛奶能快速解辣。

examples.en: Some people chew on a piece of sugar to relieve spiciness when the dish is too hot.
examples.zh: 菜太辣时，有些人会嚼一块糖来解辣。

entries.shortAnswer: 「素菜」的英文是 vegetarian dish，指不含肉、禽、海鲜的菜肴，常见于餐厅菜单。
entries.definition: vegetarian dish 指一道不含肉、禽、海鲜的菜，常用于餐厅点餐；注意区别于 vegan dish（纯素，不含蛋奶）。

examples.en: Could you recommend a vegetarian dish that isn’t too spicy?
examples.zh: 你能推荐一道不太辣的素菜吗？

examples.en: This restaurant’s vegetarian dish is made with fresh mushrooms and tofu.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的素菜是用新鲜蘑菇和豆腐做的。

entries.shortAnswer: “vegetarian dish”的中文意思是“素菜”，即不含肉类、家禽或海鲜的菜肴，常见于餐厅点餐。
entries.definition: vegetarian dish 指一道不含肉、禽、海鲜的菜，常出现在菜单或点餐中；与 vegan dish 不同，后者还排除蛋、奶、蜂蜜。

examples.en: Could you recommend a vegetarian dish that isn’t too spicy?
examples.zh: 你能推荐一道不太辣的素菜吗？

examples.en: This restaurant’s vegetarian dish is made with fresh mushrooms and tofu.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的素菜是用新鲜蘑菇和豆腐做的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「撑」说英语就是 stuffed，指吃得太饱、肚子发胀。注意 stuffed 也可表示「塞满馅料的」，如 stuffed turkey 火鸡酿馅；说人吃撑了用 I'm stuffed 最地道。
entries.definition: I'm stuffed 是口语里表示「我吃撑了」的常用说法，比 I'm full 程度更重，full 是「吃饱了」，stuffed 是「撑到不行、一口都吃不下了」。也可说 I'm so stuffed 加强语气；问别人「你撑了吗」用 Are you stuffed?

examples.en: I ate three bowls of noodles and now I'm completely stuffed.
examples.zh: 我吃了三碗面，现在撑得不行。

examples.en: Thanks, I can't eat another bite—I'm stuffed.
examples.zh: 谢谢，我一口都吃不下了，我吃撑了。

entries.shortAnswer: Stuffed means「撑」——吃得太饱、肚子塞满的感觉。它比 full（吃饱）程度更强，口语中 I'm stuffed 就是「我吃撑了」。
entries.definition: Stuffed 在饮食语境里指吃得极饱、撑得难受，常用于口语：I'm stuffed.（我吃撑了。）程度强于 full。另一常见义是「填了馅的」，如 stuffed peppers 酿甜椒、stuffed turkey 火鸡酿馅，需靠上下文区分。

examples.en: I ate three bowls of noodles and now I'm completely stuffed.
examples.zh: 我吃了三碗面，现在撑得不行。

examples.en: Thanks, I can't eat another bite—I'm stuffed.
examples.zh: 谢谢，我一口都吃不下了，我吃撑了。

entries.shortAnswer: 「垫肚子」的英文是 fill the stomach，指简单吃点东西缓解饥饿。注意：它强调临时充饥，不是正式吃饱，多用于口语。
entries.definition: fill the stomach 常与 a bit、just、quickly 连用，如 fill the stomach with a bun。易错点：别与 fill one's stomach（吃饱）混淆，垫肚子侧重暂时解饿。

examples.en: I had a piece of bread to fill the stomach before the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会前我吃了一片面包垫肚子。

examples.en: She bought some biscuits to fill the stomach during the long trip.
examples.zh: 长途旅行中她买了些饼干垫肚子。

entries.shortAnswer: 「fill the stomach」的中文意思是「垫肚子」，指吃少量食物暂时缓解饥饿。与 eat a full meal 不同，它强调临时充饥，不追求吃饱。
entries.definition: fill the stomach 为口语表达，常搭配 with snacks、a little 等，表示临时解饿。正式场合可用 satisfy one's hunger。注意：它不等于「吃饱」（be full）。

examples.en: I had a piece of bread to fill the stomach before the meeting.
examples.zh: 开会前我吃了一片面包垫肚子。

examples.en: She bought some biscuits to fill the stomach during the long trip.
examples.zh: 长途旅行中她买了些饼干垫肚子。

entries.shortAnswer: 「抢着买单」即英文 fighting over the bill，指饭后争着付账，是常见的中式人情表达。
entries.definition: 聚餐后争相付账的口语表达，常见搭配 fight over the bill，并非真打架，体现中式人情与面子文化。

examples.en: Every time we eat out, my Chinese friends end up fighting over the bill.
examples.zh: 每次出去吃饭，我的中国朋友最后都会抢着买单。

examples.en: They were fighting over the bill so loudly that the waiter had to step in.
examples.zh: 他们抢着买单的声音太大，服务员不得不出面调解。

entries.shortAnswer: Fighting over the bill means 抢着买单, competing to pay after a meal among friends.
entries.definition: Informal phrase in which friends playfully argue about who pays the check, not a real fight; Westerners often go Dutch.

examples.en: Every time we eat out, my Chinese friends end up fighting over the bill.
examples.zh: 每次出去吃饭，我的中国朋友最后都会抢着买单。

examples.en: They were fighting over the bill so loudly that the waiter had to step in.
examples.zh: 他们抢着买单的声音太大，服务员不得不出面调解。

entries.shortAnswer: 「逛街」的英文是 go shopping，特指去商店浏览和购买商品。注意：go shopping 强调购物行为，而 hang out 更侧重闲逛，不一定买东西。
entries.definition: go shopping 常与 go window shopping（只逛不买）、go shopping for clothes 等搭配。日常口语中可替换为 do some shopping，但 go shopping 更强调外出过程。

examples.en: We usually go shopping on weekends to check out the clearance sale and avoid impulse buying.
examples.zh: 我们通常在周末去逛街，看看清仓促销，避免冲动消费。

examples.en: She likes to go shopping at duty-free shops before her flight, but she never buys overstock goods from a scalper.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在起飞前去免税店逛街，但从不从黄牛那里买尾货。

entries.shortAnswer: go shopping 的中文意思是「逛街」，即去商店浏览或购买商品。它侧重外出购物的行为，而 hang out 则强调闲逛，不一定消费。
entries.definition: go shopping 是口语常用短语，指为了休闲或购买必需品而逛商店。常见搭配：go shopping for gifts, go shopping online。注意：go shopping 是固定搭配，不能说 go to shopping。

examples.en: We usually go shopping on weekends to check out the clearance sale and avoid impulse buying.
examples.zh: 我们通常在周末去逛街，看看清仓促销，避免冲动消费。

examples.en: She likes to go shopping at duty-free shops before her flight, but she never buys overstock goods from a scalper.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在起飞前去免税店逛街，但从不从黄牛那里买尾货。

entries.shortAnswer: 「锅气」的英文是 wok hei，粤语借词，指猛火爆炒的焦香锅味，别说 pot air。
entries.definition: wok hei 即粤语「镬气」，指食材在极热炒锅中快炒产生的焦香与锅味，常见搭配有 with wok hei。

examples.en: This beef chow fun is amazing—it really has that wok hei aroma.
examples.zh: 这盘干炒牛河太棒了，真的有那股锅气。

examples.en: Without a high flame, it's hard to get wok hei into the fried rice.
examples.zh: 没有猛火，很难让炒饭带上锅气。

entries.shortAnswer: wok hei means 锅气 in Chinese: the smoky, seared aroma from stir-frying in a very hot wok.
entries.definition: Wok hei is the Cantonese term for the charred, savory aroma from tossing food in a screaming-hot wok; not generic pot smell.

examples.en: This beef chow fun is amazing—it really has that wok hei aroma.
examples.zh: 这盘干炒牛河太棒了，真的有那股锅气。

examples.en: Without a high flame, it's hard to get wok hei into the fried rice.
examples.zh: 没有猛火，很难让炒饭带上锅气。

entries.shortAnswer: 「苍蝇馆子」英文说 hole-in-the-wall eatery，指不起眼却往往极好吃的小店，别译成 fly restaurant。
entries.definition: hole-in-the-wall eatery 是英语地道说法，强调店面小、装修简陋但味道出众。中文「苍蝇馆子」带亲切褒义，常说「苍蝇馆子才是隐藏的美味」；fly restaurant 只会让老外以为店里真有苍蝇。

examples.en: That hole-in-the-wall eatery near the station serves the best noodles in town.
examples.zh: 车站附近那家苍蝇馆子做的面条是城里最好吃的。

examples.en: Don't judge by the shabby front; this hole-in-the-wall eatery is always packed at dinner.
examples.zh: 别被破旧的门面骗了，这家苍蝇馆子晚饭时总是挤满人。

entries.shortAnswer: A hole-in-the-wall eatery is 苍蝇馆子 in Chinese: a small, unassuming spot with great food.
entries.definition: hole-in-the-wall eatery 指不起眼的小饭馆，常含「低调但好吃」的褒义，偏口语。与 dive（廉价酒吧）不同，它强调食物地道；不是真的有苍蝇，别理解为 fly restaurant。

examples.en: That hole-in-the-wall eatery near the station serves the best noodles in town.
examples.zh: 车站附近那家苍蝇馆子做的面条是城里最好吃的。

examples.en: Don't judge by the shabby front; this hole-in-the-wall eatery is always packed at dinner.
examples.zh: 别被破旧的门面骗了，这家苍蝇馆子晚饭时总是挤满人。

entries.shortAnswer: 会员卡用英语说是 membership card，是商家发给顾客的身份凭证，凭卡享会员价或专属权益。
entries.definition: membership card 指证明会员身份的实体卡或电子卡，常见搭配有 apply for a membership card、show your membership card，注意与 loyalty card（积分卡）区分。

examples.en: Could you show me your membership card before I apply the discount?
examples.zh: 在给您打折之前，能出示一下您的会员卡吗？

examples.en: I forgot my membership card at home, so I couldn't get the member price.
examples.zh: 我把会员卡忘在家里了，所以没能享受会员价。

entries.shortAnswer: membership card 的中文意思是会员卡，是商家发给会员的身份凭证，凭卡可享会员价和专属权益。
entries.definition: membership card 指证明会员资格的卡片，可实体可电子；常见搭配有 present a membership card、renew a membership card，与 loyalty card 区分。

examples.en: Could you show me your membership card before I apply the discount?
examples.zh: 在给您打折之前，能出示一下您的会员卡吗？

examples.en: I forgot my membership card at home, so I couldn't get the member price.
examples.zh: 我把会员卡忘在家里了，所以没能享受会员价。

entries.shortAnswer: 在购物消费场景中，收银台的英文是 checkout counter，指商店里顾客排队付款结账的柜台。
entries.definition: checkout counter 指实体店结账付款的柜台，常与 cashier、queue、pay 搭配。英式英语中也用 till。电商中 checkout 指结算页面。

examples.en: Please proceed to the checkout counter to pay for your items.
examples.zh: 请前往收银台为您的商品付款。

examples.en: There was a long queue at the checkout counter because of the clearance sale.
examples.zh: 由于清仓大甩卖，收银台前排起了长队。

entries.shortAnswer: Checkout counter 在购物消费场景中的中文意思是收银台，即商店里顾客付款结账的柜台。
entries.definition: Checkout counter 指实体店中结账付款的柜台，常见搭配 at the checkout counter, pay at the checkout counter。英式英语常用 till。

examples.en: Please proceed to the checkout counter to pay for your items.
examples.zh: 请前往收银台为您的商品付款。

examples.en: There was a long queue at the checkout counter because of the clearance sale.
examples.zh: 由于清仓大甩卖，收银台前排起了长队。

entries.shortAnswer: 「冲动消费」的英文是 impulse buying，指未加计划、受情绪驱使的购买行为。
entries.definition: 强调一时兴起、无计划，常与 avoid、encourage、regret 等动词搭配，多作不可数名词。

examples.en: Online flash sales are designed to trigger impulse buying, so I always wait a day before checking out.
examples.zh: 网络限时秒杀就是为了诱发冲动消费，所以我总会等一天再下单。

examples.en: She regretted her impulse buying after realizing most of the clothes still had tags on.
examples.zh: 她发现自己买的衣服大多还带着吊牌，便后悔了自己的冲动消费。

entries.shortAnswer: Impulse buying means 冲动消费 in Chinese: buying on a sudden urge without planning.
entries.definition: Impulse buying is unplanned, emotion-driven purchasing. An impulse buy is the item; impulse buying is the behavior.

examples.en: Online flash sales are designed to trigger impulse buying, so I always wait a day before checking out.
examples.zh: 网络限时秒杀就是为了诱发冲动消费，所以我总会等一天再下单。

examples.en: She regretted her impulse buying after realizing most of the clothes still had tags on.
examples.zh: 她发现自己买的衣服大多还带着吊牌，便后悔了自己的冲动消费。

entries.shortAnswer: “尾货”的英文是 overstock goods，指库存积压、清仓处理的剩余商品，常见于折扣店和促销语境。
entries.definition: overstock goods 是复数名词，指超出正常销量的库存商品，常搭配 buy/sell overstock goods。注意：它不是假货或二手货。

examples.en: The store is selling overstock goods at half price to clear out its warehouse.
examples.zh: 这家店半价出售尾货，以清空仓库。

examples.en: She often hunts for overstock goods online because they are authentic but much cheaper.
examples.zh: 她经常在网上淘尾货，因为它们是正品但便宜很多。

entries.shortAnswer: “overstock goods”的中文意思是“尾货”，即商家库存过多、降价清仓的商品。
entries.definition: overstock goods 指超出正常销售需求的库存商品，常以折扣价出售。常见搭配：sell/buy overstock goods。不是二手货或假货。

examples.en: The store is selling overstock goods at half price to clear out its warehouse.
examples.zh: 这家店半价出售尾货，以清空仓库。

examples.en: She often hunts for overstock goods online because they are authentic but much cheaper.
examples.zh: 她经常在网上淘尾货，因为它们是正品但便宜很多。

entries.shortAnswer: 「免税」的英文是 duty-free，指商品免交进口关税或消费税。它常修饰 shop、goods 等名词，也可作副词：buy alcohol duty-free。
entries.definition: duty-free 多作形容词或副词，指免征关税或消费税，常见于机场、港口、飞机上的免税店（duty-free shop）。注意 duty-free 不等于 tax-free：前者通常指免关税，后者常指免销售税等一般税。

examples.en: I bought some duty-free perfume at the airport before my flight.
examples.zh: 我在机场登机前买了一些免税香水。

examples.en: You can buy alcohol duty-free when you travel between countries.
examples.zh: 跨境旅行时，你可以购买免税酒类。

entries.shortAnswer: duty-free 的中文意思是「免税」，指商品免交关税或消费税。它强调免除进口税，与仅免销售税的 tax-free 不同，常见于机场和边境的免税店。
entries.definition: duty-free 作形容词或副词，指进口商品免征关税或消费税，常搭配 duty-free shop、duty-free goods、buy something duty-free。正式文体和旅游场景都常用，注意不能随意等同于 tax-free。

examples.en: I bought some duty-free perfume at the airport before my flight.
examples.zh: 我在机场登机前买了一些免税香水。

examples.en: You can buy alcohol duty-free when you travel between countries.
examples.zh: 跨境旅行时，你可以购买免税酒类。

entries.shortAnswer: 跳蚤市场的英文是 flea market，指摆摊售卖旧货、手工艺品和廉价商品的集市。
entries.definition: flea market 指临时摊位市场，卖二手货、古董和便宜杂货；常说 at a flea market。

examples.en: We spent Sunday morning browsing the flea market for vintage posters and old records.
examples.zh: 我们周日早上逛跳蚤市场，寻找复古海报和旧唱片。

examples.en: She found a rare teapot at a flea market for just a few dollars.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市场只花了几美元就淘到一个稀有的茶壶。

entries.shortAnswer: Flea market means 跳蚤市场: a market with stalls selling used goods, crafts, and cheap items.
entries.definition: A flea market is a temporary market with stalls selling used goods, antiques, and bargains. Say at a flea market.

examples.en: We spent Sunday morning browsing the flea market for vintage posters and old records.
examples.zh: 我们周日早上逛跳蚤市场，寻找复古海报和旧唱片。

examples.en: She found a rare teapot at a flea market for just a few dollars.
examples.zh: 她在跳蚤市场只花了几美元就淘到一个稀有的茶壶。

entries.translation: add items to reach a discount
entries.shortAnswer: 「凑单」英文是 add items to reach a discount，为满减或免邮多加商品。
entries.definition: 凑单 = add items to reach a discount，指为达到满减或包邮门槛而额外购买商品，常出现在电商场景，口语也说 top up the cart。

examples.en: I only needed a ten-dollar item, but I added items to reach a discount and spent thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 我本来只缺十美元的东西，但为了凑单反而花了三十美元。

examples.en: To avoid shipping fees, she added items to reach a discount, saying she was just topping up the cart.
examples.zh: 为了免运费，她凑单加了几件商品，说自己只是把购物车凑够门槛。

entries.term: add items to reach a discount
entries.shortAnswer: 「add items to reach a discount」意思是「凑单」，为满减或免邮门槛多买商品。
entries.definition: add items to reach a discount 对应中文「凑单」，用于电商满减、包邮场景，口语常说 top up the cart，与 impulse buying 不同。

examples.en: I only needed a ten-dollar item, but I added items to reach a discount and spent thirty dollars.
examples.zh: 我本来只缺十美元的东西，但为了凑单反而花了三十美元。

examples.en: To avoid shipping fees, she added items to reach a discount, saying she was just topping up the cart.
examples.zh: 为了免运费，她凑单加了几件商品，说自己只是把购物车凑够门槛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「清仓」的英文是 clearance sale，指商家为了清空库存而低价甩卖。注意它强调"清光存货"，不是单纯打折，日常也说 going out of business sale。
entries.definition: clearance sale 常指季末或歇业前的清货促销，搭配 hold/have a clearance sale。与 on sale（泛指打折）不同，它侧重清空库存。英式口语也说 clearance。

examples.en: The store is holding a clearance sale to make room for new arrivals.
examples.zh: 这家店正在清仓甩卖，为新货腾出空间。

examples.en: I bought this jacket at a clearance sale for half price.
examples.zh: 我在清仓促销时半价买了这件夹克。

entries.shortAnswer: "clearance sale" 的中文意思是「清仓」，指商家为清空库存而大幅降价出售商品。它强调的是清光存货，而不仅是普通促销打折。
entries.definition: clearance sale 指清仓促销，常见搭配 have/hold a clearance sale、clearance sale prices。比 on sale 语气更强，多用于季末、换季或关店前，价格通常最低。

examples.en: The store is holding a clearance sale to make room for new arrivals.
examples.zh: 这家店正在清仓甩卖，为新货腾出空间。

examples.en: I bought this jacket at a clearance sale for half price.
examples.zh: 我在清仓促销时半价买了这件夹克。

entries.shortAnswer: 购物袋的英文是 shopping bag，指商场或超市提供的装商品袋子；注意拼写为 shopping bag，不是 shop bag 或 shoppingbag。
entries.definition: shopping bag 是购物时用来装物品的袋子，常见搭配有 reusable shopping bag（环保购物袋）、paper shopping bag（纸购物袋）。在英式英语中，也可用 carrier bag 指超市购物袋。

examples.en: I always bring a reusable shopping bag to the supermarket to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 我总是带一个可重复使用的购物袋去超市，以减少塑料浪费。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I needed a shopping bag for my groceries.
examples.zh: 收银员问我是否需要购物袋来装食品杂货。

entries.shortAnswer: Shopping bag 的中文意思是“购物袋”，即购物时用来装东西的袋子；它与 tote bag 不同，tote bag 通常指日常手提包或帆布袋，不限于购物场景。
entries.definition: Shopping bag 指商店提供的用于携带所购物品的袋子，常见搭配有 reusable shopping bag、plastic shopping bag。在英式英语中，carrier bag 更常指超市购物袋，而 shopping bag 更通用。

examples.en: I always bring a reusable shopping bag to the supermarket to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 我总是带一个可重复使用的购物袋去超市，以减少塑料浪费。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I needed a shopping bag for my groceries.
examples.zh: 收银员问我是否需要购物袋来装食品杂货。

entries.shortAnswer: 「爆款」的英文是 best seller，指销量极高、供不应求、常被抢购的商品。
entries.definition: best seller 多作名词，常搭配 become/be a best seller。中文「爆款」偏电商口语，可指一时爆红单品；英文更看重实际销量榜单。

examples.en: This lightweight sunscreen became a best seller within a week of its launch.
examples.zh: 这款轻薄的防晒霜上市一周就成了爆款。

examples.en: The store restocked the best seller three times before the holiday sale ended.
examples.zh: 假期促销结束前，这家店把这款爆款补了三次货。

entries.shortAnswer: 「best seller」的中文意思是「爆款」，指卖得最好、销量遥遥领先的畅销商品。
entries.definition: best seller 指销量名列前茅的商品或书，常见 a best seller、become a best seller。正式商业报道与书评常用，口语也常见。

examples.en: This lightweight sunscreen became a best seller within a week of its launch.
examples.zh: 这款轻薄的防晒霜上市一周就成了爆款。

examples.en: The store restocked the best seller three times before the holiday sale ended.
examples.zh: 假期促销结束前，这家店把这款爆款补了三次货。

entries.shortAnswer: 「过季」英文是 out of season，指商品过了当季销售期，常打折清仓；也指不合时宜。
entries.definition: out of season 在购物中表示服装、果蔬等已过当季，常搭配 sale、clearance、discount，如 out-of-season clothes 过季服装。也可表示不合时宜。注意与 off-season（淡季、休赛期）区分。

examples.en: These winter coats are out of season now, so they're on clearance sale.
examples.zh: 这些冬装现在过季了，所以在清仓促销。

examples.en: Buying out of season fruits can save money, but the taste often isn't as good.
examples.zh: 购买过季水果能省钱，但味道往往不如当季的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「out of season」中文意思是「过季」，指商品过当季销售期，常打折清仓；也指不合时宜。
entries.definition: out of season 核心义为过季的，用于服装、果蔬等，常搭配 sale、clearance、discount，如 out-of-season produce。口语中也可表示不合时宜。注意与 off-season（淡季、休赛期）区分。

examples.en: These winter coats are out of season now, so they're on clearance sale.
examples.zh: 这些冬装现在过季了，所以在清仓促销。

examples.en: Buying out of season fruits can save money, but the taste often isn't as good.
examples.zh: 购买过季水果能省钱，但味道往往不如当季的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「按斤称」的英文是 sold by weight，指散装称重售卖；注意「斤」是500克，英文中不说 jin，可说 500g per jin。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：sold by weight（按重量出售）、by the jin（按斤）。易错点：欧美超市多为 pre-packaged 固定包装定价，散装称重较少，需向英语学习者说明零售文化差异。

examples.en: In Chinese wet markets, fresh produce is usually sold by weight, so you can buy exactly how much you need.
examples.zh: 在中国菜市场，生鲜通常按斤称，所以你可以想买多少就买多少。

examples.en: Unlike pre-packaged snacks in Western supermarkets, these bulk candies are sold by weight, allowing customers to mix and match.
examples.zh: 与欧美超市的固定包装零食不同，这些散装糖果按斤称，顾客可以随意混搭。

entries.shortAnswer: sold by weight 的中文意思是「按斤称」，即按重量计价售卖；它与固定包装的 pre-packaged 相对，常见于散装商品。
entries.definition: 核心义：按重量单位计价出售。搭配：be sold by weight, sell by weight。口语中也可说 by the pound/kilo。注意：中文的「斤」等于500克，不要直接说 jin。

examples.en: In Chinese wet markets, fresh produce is usually sold by weight, so you can buy exactly how much you need.
examples.zh: 在中国菜市场，生鲜通常按斤称，所以你可以想买多少就买多少。

examples.en: Unlike pre-packaged snacks in Western supermarkets, these bulk candies are sold by weight, allowing customers to mix and match.
examples.zh: 与欧美超市的固定包装零食不同，这些散装糖果按斤称，顾客可以随意混搭。

entries.shortAnswer: 「假一赔十」的英文是 tenfold compensation for fakes，指中国电商承诺售假按售价十倍赔偿，欧美无同款法定承诺。
entries.definition: 常用作商家承诺或平台标语，强调对假货的惩罚性赔偿，多见于商品详情页。英文可意译为 tenfold compensation for fakes。

examples.en: The online store promises tenfold compensation for fakes, so customers feel safer buying brand-name goods.
examples.zh: 这家网店承诺假一赔十，所以顾客买品牌商品时更放心。

examples.en: Under the policy of tenfold compensation for fakes, the seller had to pay ten times the price after selling a counterfeit bag.
examples.zh: 根据假一赔十的政策，卖家在售出假包后必须支付十倍于售价的赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「tenfold compensation for fakes」即「假一赔十」，指中国电商卖家承诺售假则按售价十倍赔偿，属惩罚性承诺，英文无完全对等说法。
entries.definition: 该短语描述中国消保承诺或电商标语，可译为 tenfold compensation for counterfeit goods，口语说 get ten times your money back if it's fake。

examples.en: The online store promises tenfold compensation for fakes, so customers feel safer buying brand-name goods.
examples.zh: 这家网店承诺假一赔十，所以顾客买品牌商品时更放心。

examples.en: Under the policy of tenfold compensation for fakes, the seller had to pay ten times the price after selling a counterfeit bag.
examples.zh: 根据假一赔十的政策，卖家在售出假包后必须支付十倍于售价的赔偿。

entries.shortAnswer: 「砍单」的英文是 order cancellation，指订单被取消。cancel an order 是动作，order cancellation 是行为或结果。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：the seller canceled the order、a wave of order cancellations。砍单多指商家主动取消，不同于买家退货 return。

examples.en: The store issued an order cancellation because the item was out of stock.
examples.zh: 由于商品缺货，店家直接砍单了。

examples.en: After a wave of order cancellations, the seller apologized and offered coupons.
examples.zh: 经历一波砍单潮后，卖家道歉并发放了优惠券。

entries.shortAnswer: order cancellation 的中文意思是「砍单」，即取消订单。它指取消行为或结果，cancel an order 则是动词短语。
entries.definition: 常见于电商条款和客服邮件，口语也说 cancel my order 或 get canceled。注意与 return（退货）、refund（退款）区分。

examples.en: The store issued an order cancellation because the item was out of stock.
examples.zh: 由于商品缺货，店家直接砍单了。

examples.en: After a wave of order cancellations, the seller apologized and offered coupons.
examples.zh: 经历一波砍单潮后，卖家道歉并发放了优惠券。

entries.shortAnswer: 「开箱」的英文是 unboxing，指拆开新购商品包装并展示的过程。它通常用于数码、美妆等测评视频，不是简单说 open the box。
entries.definition: unboxing 多指博主或消费者拍摄的拆箱展示，常见搭配有 unboxing video、unboxing experience。日常随手拆快递别用 unboxing，那只是 open a package。

examples.en: She filmed an unboxing of her new phone and shared it with her followers.
examples.zh: 她拍了一段新手机的开箱视频，分享给粉丝。

examples.en: The unboxing experience matters a lot to online shoppers.
examples.zh: 开箱体验对网购消费者来说很重要。

entries.shortAnswer: Unboxing means 开箱，即拆开新商品包装并展示内容的过程。它强调首次开箱的展示性，与单纯 open a box 不同。
entries.definition: unboxing 指拍摄或直播拆开新购物品包装，常见于数码、美妆测评。搭配有 unboxing video、do an unboxing。口语也说 unbox sth，注意它不是普通拆快递。

examples.en: She filmed an unboxing of her new phone and shared it with her followers.
examples.zh: 她拍了一段新手机的开箱视频，分享给粉丝。

examples.en: The unboxing experience matters a lot to online shoppers.
examples.zh: 开箱体验对网购消费者来说很重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 以旧换新的英文是 trade-in，指把旧商品折价抵扣新商品货款。名词或定语，动词写作 trade in。
entries.definition: trade-in 指旧物折价抵扣新货款，常见搭配 trade-in value、trade-in offer。作动词写 trade in，如 trade in old phone。

examples.en: The store offers a trade-in program that lets you swap your old phone for credit toward a new one.
examples.zh: 这家店提供以旧换新项目，你可以用旧手机折价购买新手机。

examples.en: I traded in my old car and got a decent trade-in value on the new model.
examples.zh: 我把旧车拿去以旧换新，在新车型上拿到了不错的折价。

entries.shortAnswer: trade-in 的中文意思是「以旧换新」，指用旧物品折价抵扣购买新物品。它强调交出旧物，而非单纯降价。
entries.definition: trade-in 指旧商品折价换购新商品，常见搭配 trade-in value、trade-in deal。作动词写 trade in，中间不加连字符。

examples.en: The store offers a trade-in program that lets you swap your old phone for credit toward a new one.
examples.zh: 这家店提供以旧换新项目，你可以用旧手机折价购买新手机。

examples.en: I traded in my old car and got a decent trade-in value on the new model.
examples.zh: 我把旧车拿去以旧换新，在新车型上拿到了不错的折价。

entries.shortAnswer: 「刷单」的英文是 fake orders，指伪造订单与评价的违规行为。它属于中国电商生态特有的黑产，英文媒体也借用 brushify 或 click farming 来描述类似操作。
entries.definition: 刷单常译为 fake orders 或 order farming，指商家通过虚假交易抬高销量和好评。它不同于普通促销，而是平台禁止的违规行为；相关搭配有 fake reviews、sales manipulation。

examples.en: The platform banned several shops for using fake orders to boost their ratings.
examples.zh: 该平台封禁了多家店铺，因为它们用刷单来抬高评分。

examples.en: Consumer groups warn that fake orders mislead shoppers into trusting unreliable sellers.
examples.zh: 消费者组织警告，刷单会误导购物者去信任不可靠的卖家。

entries.shortAnswer: “fake orders”中文意思是「刷单」，指电商中伪造订单和评价以虚增销量的违规行为。它与普通假订单不同，核心是人为制造虚假交易记录和好评。
entries.definition: fake orders 常译为刷单，指商家伪造交易和评价来提升排名。常见搭配有 place fake orders、fake order farming。该词多用于电商、消费维权和平台治理语境，属贬义。

examples.en: The platform banned several shops for using fake orders to boost their ratings.
examples.zh: 该平台封禁了多家店铺，因为它们用刷单来抬高评分。

examples.en: Consumer groups warn that fake orders mislead shoppers into trusting unreliable sellers.
examples.zh: 消费者组织警告，刷单会误导购物者去信任不可靠的卖家。

entries.shortAnswer: 海淘的英文是 overseas online shopping，指直接从海外网站下单并跨境收货。注意它强调“跨境网购”这一行为，不含代购。
entries.definition: 海淘常用搭配：do overseas online shopping、overseas online shopping site。易错点：代购是 daigou，海淘是自己下单，别混用。

examples.en: She does overseas online shopping every Black Friday to grab duty-free deals and avoid impulse buying.
examples.zh: 她每年黑色星期五都海淘，抢免税优惠并避免冲动消费。

examples.en: Overseas online shopping can be tricky when it comes to clearance sale items, overstock goods, and trade-in policies.
examples.zh: 海淘清仓商品、尾货和以旧换新政策时可能会比较麻烦。

entries.shortAnswer: overseas online shopping 的中文意思是海淘，指消费者在境外电商网站下单并跨境收货。它比 cross-border shopping 更强调网购这一渠道。
entries.definition: overseas online shopping 为中性/正式用语，常见于购物、物流和税务语境，如 duty-free、clearance sale、unboxing。注意它不等于代购。

examples.en: She does overseas online shopping every Black Friday to grab duty-free deals and avoid impulse buying.
examples.zh: 她每年黑色星期五都海淘，抢免税优惠并避免冲动消费。

examples.en: Overseas online shopping can be tricky when it comes to clearance sale items, overstock goods, and trade-in policies.
examples.zh: 海淘清仓商品、尾货和以旧换新政策时可能会比较麻烦。

entries.shortAnswer: 「晒单」的英文是 post a review with photos，指在电商平台上传实物照片并写使用感受，常与返现活动搭配。
entries.definition: 晒单指买家收货后在淘宝、京东等平台上传实拍图并附文字评价，常搭配 post a review with photos；与 unboxing 不同，它侧重使用反馈而非开箱。

examples.en: After trying the skincare set for a week, I decided to post a review with photos so others could see the real texture.
examples.zh: 试用那套护肤品一周后，我决定晒单，让别人看到真实的质地。

examples.en: The seller offered a small refund if buyers post a review with photos, but I only do it when I genuinely like the product.
examples.zh: 卖家提供小额返现鼓励买家晒单，但我只在真心喜欢商品时才这么做。

entries.shortAnswer: 「post a review with photos」的中文意思是「晒单」，指在电商平台上传实物照片并写使用评价，强调评价附带图片。
entries.definition: post a review with photos 指购买后在电商平台发布带图评价，常见于淘宝、京东等；与 write a review 相比，它突出图片证据，口语中也说 post a photo review。

examples.en: After trying the skincare set for a week, I decided to post a review with photos so others could see the real texture.
examples.zh: 试用那套护肤品一周后，我决定晒单，让别人看到真实的质地。

examples.en: The seller offered a small refund if buyers post a review with photos, but I only do it when I genuinely like the product.
examples.zh: 卖家提供小额返现鼓励买家晒单，但我只在真心喜欢商品时才这么做。

entries.shortAnswer: 「宰客」的英文是 rip off customers，指商家对顾客（尤指游客）漫天要价。最地道的关联说法是 tourist trap（游客陷阱），常见于景区餐厅和出租车绕路抬价。
entries.definition: rip off customers 强调故意多收钱、坑骗顾客；rip-off 可作名词，如「That's a rip-off!」。注意与 charge a premium（合理溢价）区分，宰客含欺诈和恶意。景区、出租车、纪念品店是高频场景。

examples.en: That restaurant near the beach is a tourist trap and tries to rip off customers with overpriced seafood.
examples.zh: 海滩附近那家餐厅是个游客陷阱，用天价海鲜宰客。

examples.en: Some taxi drivers take a longer route to rip off customers, especially those who don't know the city.
examples.zh: 有些出租车司机绕远路宰客，尤其是对那些不熟悉城市的乘客。

entries.shortAnswer: 「rip off customers」的中文意思是「宰客」，即商家对顾客（尤其游客）漫天要价或坑骗。与 overcharge 相比，rip off 更强调欺诈性和不道德。
entries.definition: rip off customers 是动词短语，口语常用，指故意多收钱、坑骗顾客。名词形式 rip-off 指宰客行为或贵得离谱的东西。常见搭配：rip off tourists / get ripped off。正式场合可用 exploit customers。

examples.en: That restaurant near the beach is a tourist trap and tries to rip off customers with overpriced seafood.
examples.zh: 海滩附近那家餐厅是个游客陷阱，用天价海鲜宰客。

examples.en: Some taxi drivers take a longer route to rip off customers, especially those who don't know the city.
examples.zh: 有些出租车司机绕远路宰客，尤其是对那些不熟悉城市的乘客。

entries.shortAnswer: 「好评返现」英文常说 cashback for good reviews，指商家返小额现金换好评。
entries.definition: 常见搭配 offer/provide cashback for good reviews；中性说法为 incentive for positive reviews，正式场合更宜用后者。

examples.en: Many Taobao sellers quietly offer cashback for good reviews by slipping a small card into the package.
examples.zh: 很多淘宝卖家会在包裹里塞一张小卡片，悄悄提供好评返现。

examples.en: Platforms ban cashback for good reviews, yet shoppers still get messages asking them to rate five stars first.
examples.zh: 平台明令禁止好评返现，但买家仍会收到要求先打五星的消息。

entries.shortAnswer: "cashback for good reviews" is 「好评返现」: sellers refund a little cash for positive reviews.
entries.definition: A gray Chinese e-commerce practice: sellers offer small cash rebates to get good reviews; platforms ban it.

examples.en: Many Taobao sellers quietly offer cashback for good reviews by slipping a small card into the package.

examples.en: Platforms ban cashback for good reviews, yet shoppers still get messages asking them to rate five stars first.
