entries.shortAnswer: 「均码」的英文是 one size fits all，常见于服装标签，表示一个尺码适合大多数人，但不保证人人合身。
entries.definition: one size fits all 可作形容词，也可写成 one-size-fits-all，表示不细分码数、靠宽松或弹性适配，常出现在服装标签和购物页面中。

examples.en: This beanie is one size fits all, so you don't need to worry about choosing a size when you buy it online.
examples.zh: 这顶毛线帽是均码，所以你在网购时不用担心选尺码的问题。

examples.en: The store labeled the dress as one size fits all, but many customers still complained that it was too tight.
examples.zh: 这家店把那条连衣裙标为均码，但很多顾客仍抱怨穿着太紧。

entries.shortAnswer: 「one size fits all」的中文意思是「均码」，指服装不分尺码、一个号适合大多数人穿，但不保证人人合身。
entries.definition: one size fits all 是购物消费类常见表达，可作形容词或名词短语，指不区分尺码、单一尺码适合多数人的服装设计。

examples.en: This beanie is one size fits all, so you don't need to worry about choosing a size when you buy it online.
examples.zh: 这顶毛线帽是均码，所以你在网购时不用担心选尺码的问题。

examples.en: The store labeled the dress as one size fits all, but many customers still complained that it was too tight.
examples.zh: 这家店把那条连衣裙标为均码，但很多顾客仍抱怨穿着太紧。

entries.shortAnswer: 中文「黄牛」常译作 ticket scalper，指抢购门票后加价倒卖的人，带明显贬义。
entries.definition: ticket scalper 指抢购演出或体育门票再加价倒卖的人，含贬义；相关动词为 scalp tickets。

examples.en: I refused to pay triple the price to a ticket scalper outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 我不愿在场馆外向黄牛付三倍的价钱。

examples.en: Ticket scalpers were asking absurd amounts online after the concert sold out.
examples.zh: 演唱会售罄后，黄牛在网上开出离谱的高价。

entries.shortAnswer: 「黄牛」 is ticket scalper: someone who buys tickets in bulk and resells them at inflated prices.
entries.definition: ticket scalper: a person who buys tickets in bulk and resells them at inflated prices, often illegally outside venues or online.

examples.en: I refused to pay triple the price to a ticket scalper outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 我不愿在场馆外向黄牛付三倍的价钱。

examples.en: Ticket scalpers were asking absurd amounts online after the concert sold out.
examples.zh: 演唱会售罄后，黄牛在网上开出离谱的高价。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拉伸」的英文是 stretching，指提高柔韧性、放松肌肉的动作；注意它与热身（warm-up）不同，热身通常包含动态动作。
entries.definition: stretching 不可数，常搭配 do stretching、static/dynamic stretching。指运动前后提高柔韧性或放松肌肉的动作；热身 warm-up 是运动前升高心率和体温的整体准备，可能包含动态拉伸，但不等同于拉伸。

examples.en: After a long run, I always do some stretching to relax my tight leg muscles.
examples.zh: 长跑之后，我总是做一些拉伸来放松紧绷的腿部肌肉。

examples.en: Dynamic stretching before a workout can help prepare your body for squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 锻炼前做动态拉伸有助于让身体为深蹲和俯卧撑做好准备。

entries.shortAnswer: Stretching 的中文意思是「拉伸」，指伸展肌肉、提高柔韧性的动作；它常与 warm-up（热身）不同，warm-up 更侧重运动前准备。
entries.definition: Stretching 指伸展肌肉以提高柔韧性或放松，常见搭配 do stretching、static/dynamic stretching。在健身语境中，它应与 warm-up（热身）区分：热身多为运动前动态准备，拉伸可独立进行或作为其中一环。

examples.en: After a long run, I always do some stretching to relax my tight leg muscles.
examples.zh: 长跑之后，我总是做一些拉伸来放松紧绷的腿部肌肉。

examples.en: Dynamic stretching before a workout can help prepare your body for squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 锻炼前做动态拉伸有助于让身体为深蹲和俯卧撑做好准备。

entries.shortAnswer: 痘痘的英文是 pimple。注意 pimple 通常指单个小脓包或红肿点，而 acne 是痘痘的统称，口语更常用 pimple 指具体一颗。
entries.definition: pimple 是可数名词，指脸上或身上冒出的单个小疙瘩，常搭配 pop a pimple（挤痘痘）、get a pimple（长痘痘）。若指成片、反复发作的痤疮，英语常用 acne 或 acne breakout，而不用 pimple。

examples.en: I woke up with a big pimple on my nose, so I tried not to touch it.
examples.zh: 我醒来发现鼻子上冒了一颗大痘痘，所以尽量不去碰它。

examples.en: She uses a gentle cleanser every night to keep pimples from getting worse.
examples.zh: 她每晚用温和的洁面乳，防止痘痘变得更严重。

entries.shortAnswer: pimple 的中文意思是痘痘。它特指一颗颗的小疙瘩或小脓包，而 acne 是痘痘的医学统称，通常指成片、反复的痤疮问题。
entries.definition: pimple 是日常口语词，指皮肤上冒出的单个小突起，常见搭配有 pop a pimple、get a pimple。正式或医学语境指痤疮整体时用 acne；说某人长痘可讲 have pimples 或 break out。

examples.en: I woke up with a big pimple on my nose, so I tried not to touch it.
examples.zh: 我醒来发现鼻子上冒了一颗大痘痘，所以尽量不去碰它。

examples.en: She uses a gentle cleanser every night to keep pimples from getting worse.
examples.zh: 她每晚用温和的洁面乳，防止痘痘变得更严重。

entries.shortAnswer: 「热身」的英文是 warm-up exercise，指正式运动前的低强度准备活动，动词短语写作 warm up。
entries.definition: warm-up exercise 指运动前的低强度准备活动，如慢跑、动态拉伸，用于升高体温、激活肌肉、减少受伤。名词写 warm-up，动词写 warm up。

examples.en: Do a few warm-up exercises before you start lifting weights.
examples.zh: 开始举重之前先做几组热身运动。

examples.en: A proper warm-up exercise routine can lower your risk of injury during squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 一套合适的热身运动流程可以降低你做深蹲和俯卧撑时受伤的风险。

entries.shortAnswer: A warm-up exercise is 「热身」: light activity before a workout that prepares the body.
entries.definition: A warm-up exercise is gentle activity like jogging or dynamic stretching done before training to raise body temperature and prevent injury.

examples.en: Do a few warm-up exercises before you start lifting weights.
examples.zh: 开始举重之前先做几组热身运动。

examples.en: A proper warm-up exercise routine can lower your risk of injury during squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 一套合适的热身运动流程可以降低你做深蹲和俯卧撑时受伤的风险。

entries.shortAnswer: 「肌肉酸痛」的英文是 muscle soreness，指运动后延迟出现的酸痛，需与拉伤区分。
entries.definition: muscle soreness 指运动后 24-72 小时出现的迟发性肌肉酸痛，即 DOMS，常见于抗阻训练后。搭配 feel/relieve muscle soreness。

examples.en: I always feel muscle soreness in my legs after doing squats and lunges.
examples.zh: 做完深蹲和弓步后，我的腿总是肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: Gentle stretching can help relieve muscle soreness after push-ups.
examples.zh: 温和的拉伸有助于缓解俯卧撑后的肌肉酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: Muscle soreness means 肌肉酸痛 in Chinese, the delayed ache after exercise, not a muscle strain.
entries.definition: Muscle soreness is the ache in muscles 24-72 hours after exercise, known as DOMS. Collocations: feel or relieve muscle soreness.

examples.en: I always feel muscle soreness in my legs after doing squats and lunges.
examples.zh: 做完深蹲和弓步后，我的腿总是肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: Gentle stretching can help relieve muscle soreness after push-ups.
examples.zh: 温和的拉伸有助于缓解俯卧撑后的肌肉酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「黑眼圈」的英文是 dark circles，通常用复数，指眼周暗沉，也可说 dark circles under the eyes。
entries.definition: dark circles 指眼周暗沉，常与疲劳、熬夜、遗传有关。常见搭配有 get/have dark circles，美妆语境可说 cover dark circles。

examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night, so I woke up with dark circles under my eyes.
examples.zh: 我昨晚没睡好，所以醒来时眼睛下面有了黑眼圈。

examples.en: She uses a concealer to cover her dark circles before going to work.
examples.zh: 她上班前用遮瑕膏遮住自己的黑眼圈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「dark circles」的中文意思是「黑眼圈」，指眼下暗色环状区域，通常用复数，单数 dark circle 很少使用。
entries.definition: dark circles 指眼周暗沉，常因疲劳、睡眠不足或遗传产生。常见搭配有 get/have dark circles，美妆语境可说 cover dark circles。

examples.en: I didn't sleep well last night, so I woke up with dark circles under my eyes.
examples.zh: 我昨晚没睡好，所以醒来时眼睛下面有了黑眼圈。

examples.en: She uses a concealer to cover her dark circles before going to work.
examples.zh: 她上班前用遮瑕膏遮住自己的黑眼圈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「皮肤干燥」用英语说是 dry skin，指皮肤缺水缺油、容易起皮紧绷的状态，常见于秋冬或干性肤质。
entries.definition: dry skin 是形容词加名词的固定搭配，描述皮肤干燥、起皮、紧绷。常见搭配有 have dry skin、dry skin care。

examples.en: In winter, my dry skin often feels tight and flaky, so I use a richer moisturizer.
examples.zh: 冬天我的皮肤干燥，常常感觉紧绷起皮，所以我会用更滋润的面霜。

examples.en: If you have dry skin, avoid washing your face with hot water because it strips natural oils.
examples.zh: 如果你是干性皮肤，避免用热水洗脸，因为热水会带走天然油脂。

entries.shortAnswer: 「dry skin」的中文意思是「皮肤干燥」，指皮肤缺水缺油、容易起皮紧绷的状态，多见于秋冬或干性肤质。
entries.definition: dry skin 指皮肤干燥，常与 have、get 连用，如 I have dry skin。美容语境中常搭配 moisturizer。

examples.en: In winter, my dry skin often feels tight and flaky, so I use a richer moisturizer.
examples.zh: 冬天我的皮肤干燥，常常感觉紧绷起皮，所以我会用更滋润的面霜。

examples.en: If you have dry skin, avoid washing your face with hot water because it strips natural oils.
examples.zh: 如果你是干性皮肤，避免用热水洗脸，因为热水会带走天然油脂。

entries.shortAnswer: 美白的英文是 skin whitening，指通过护肤或医美手段让肤色变浅、提亮。
entries.definition: skin whitening 常指用精华或医美淡化黑色素、提亮肤色；日常也说 brightening，以避开敏感联想。

examples.en: She uses a skin whitening serum to even out her skin tone.
examples.zh: 她使用一款美白精华来均匀肤色。

examples.en: Many dermatologists recommend skin whitening treatments for fading dark spots.
examples.zh: 许多皮肤科医生推荐用美白疗程来淡化色斑。

entries.shortAnswer: Skin whitening means 美白, lightening skin tone with skincare or medical treatments.
entries.definition: Skin whitening uses products or treatments to reduce melanin and even out tone; brightening is a softer term.

examples.en: She uses a skin whitening serum to even out her skin tone.
examples.zh: 她使用一款美白精华来均匀肤色。

examples.en: Many dermatologists recommend skin whitening treatments for fading dark spots.
examples.zh: 许多皮肤科医生推荐用美白疗程来淡化色斑。

entries.shortAnswer: 护肤品的英文是 skincare products。日常口语也常用 skincare 单指护肤品，但正式场合或强调产品时宜用完整短语 skincare products。
entries.definition: skincare products 是复数名词短语，泛指面霜、精华、洁面等护肤产品；英式拼写常作 skincare，美式亦写 skin care。注意与 makeup（化妆品）区别，护肤品侧重护理而非修饰。

examples.en: She spends a lot of money on skincare products, especially serums and moisturizers.
examples.zh: 她在护肤品上花了很多钱，尤其是精华和保湿霜。

examples.en: Before traveling, I always pack my essential skincare products like sunscreen and cleanser.
examples.zh: 旅行前，我总是会带上防晒霜和洁面乳等必备护肤品。

entries.shortAnswer: Skincare products 中文意思是护肤品。它统指护理皮肤的产品，与 cosmetic products（美容产品，可能含彩妆）不同，更强调清洁、保湿、防护等护肤功能。
entries.definition: Skincare products 是复数名词短语，指面霜、精华、洁面等护肤品，正式和口语均常用。英式拼写常连写为 skincare，美式可分开写 skin care。注意不要与 makeup（彩妆）混淆。

examples.en: She spends a lot of money on skincare products, especially serums and moisturizers.
examples.zh: 她在护肤品上花了很多钱，尤其是精华和保湿霜。

examples.en: Before traveling, I always pack my essential skincare products like sunscreen and cleanser.
examples.zh: 旅行前，我总是会带上防晒霜和洁面乳等必备护肤品。

entries.shortAnswer: 「化妆」的英文是 put on makeup，表示涂抹化妆品、修饰面容的动作。注意 makeup 是名词，动词短语要加 put on；只说 makeup 则是名词。
entries.definition: put on makeup 强调「上妆」这一动作过程，常用于日常口语；名词形式是 makeup（不可数），如 wear makeup 表示「化着妆」。若指化妆这个行为本身，也可说 do one's makeup，但 do makeup 更偏专业化妆师的工作。

examples.en: She spends about ten minutes putting on makeup every morning before work.
examples.zh: 她每天早上上班前花大约十分钟化妆。

examples.en: If you're going to the party, you might want to put on some makeup first.
examples.zh: 如果你要去参加派对，也许最好先化点妆。

entries.shortAnswer: put on makeup 的中文意思是「化妆」，指往脸上涂抹化妆品来修饰容貌。它强调上妆的动作，而 wear makeup 强调化着妆的状态，两者侧重点不同。
entries.definition: put on makeup 是口语常用的动词短语，表示「上妆、化妆」；名词 makeup 不可数，搭配 wear/apply/remove makeup。日常说 do one's makeup 也指化妆，但偏打理妆容的过程；正式场合多用 apply makeup。

examples.en: She spends about ten minutes putting on makeup every morning before work.
examples.zh: 她每天早上上班前花大约十分钟化妆。

examples.en: If you're going to the party, you might want to put on some makeup first.
examples.zh: 如果你要去参加派对，也许最好先化点妆。

entries.shortAnswer: 「卸妆」的英文是 makeup remover，指卸除彩妆的产品。注意动词「卸妆」常用 remove makeup，而 makeup remover 是名词，指卸妆产品。
entries.definition: makeup remover 是名词，指卸妆水、卸妆油等产品。常见搭配：use makeup remover、gentle makeup remover。动词「卸妆」应说 remove makeup，例如 I need to remove my makeup。

examples.en: She used a gentle makeup remover to take off her eye makeup.
examples.zh: 她用了温和的卸妆液来卸眼妆。

examples.en: I always keep makeup remover wipes in my gym bag.
examples.zh: 我总是在健身包里放卸妆湿巾。

entries.shortAnswer: Makeup remover 的中文意思是「卸妆」，指卸除彩妆的产品。与 cleanser 不同，它专门针对彩妆，尤其是防水化妆品。
entries.definition: makeup remover 是名词，指卸妆产品，常见搭配：use makeup remover、apply makeup remover。动词形式是 remove makeup。口语中也可说 take off makeup。注意不要与 cleanser（洗面奶）混淆。

examples.en: She used a gentle makeup remover to take off her eye makeup.
examples.zh: 她用了温和的卸妆液来卸眼妆。

examples.en: I always keep makeup remover wipes in my gym bag.
examples.zh: 我总是在健身包里放卸妆湿巾。

entries.shortAnswer: 「理发」的英文是 haircut，既指剪发行为也指发型。注意：haircut 是可数名词，get a haircut 才是「去理发」；haircut 不是动词，不能直接说 I haircut。
entries.definition: 表示「理发」常用 get/have a haircut，如 I need to get a haircut。haircut 指剪发行为或剪后的发型，不可数用法错误；动词「剪头发」用 cut one's hair 或 have one's hair cut。

examples.en: I need to get a haircut before the job interview next week.
examples.zh: 下周面试前我需要去理个发。

examples.en: She got a new haircut and everyone said it made her look younger.
examples.zh: 她换了个新发型，大家都说她看起来更年轻了。

entries.shortAnswer: Haircut 中文意思是「理发」，指剪头发的行为或剪后的发型。它和 hairstyle 不同：haircut 强调剪这个动作或结果，hairstyle 更强调日常造型风格。
entries.definition: Haircut 是可数名词，常见搭配 get/have a haircut，意为去理发；也可指剪后的发型，如 a short haircut。口语中 haircut 不表示「发型设计」，发型设计多用 hairstyle 或 hairdo。

examples.en: I need to get a haircut before the job interview next week.
examples.zh: 下周面试前我需要去理个发。

examples.en: She got a new haircut and everyone said it made her look younger.
examples.zh: 她换了个新发型，大家都说她看起来更年轻了。

entries.shortAnswer: 面膜的英文是 face mask。日常护肤说 apply a face mask 很自然，注意 sheet mask 指片状面膜，而泥膜等 wash-off mask 用法不同。
entries.definition: face mask 可作名词，搭配 apply/use/wear a face mask；片状面膜常说 sheet mask。做面膜的行为用 apply a face mask 或 put on a face mask，避免只动词 mask 造成歧义。

examples.en: After a long week, I like to apply a hydrating face mask and relax at home.
examples.zh: 忙了一周后，我喜欢敷一张补水面膜，在家放松一下。

examples.en: She uses a clay face mask twice a week to control excess oil.
examples.zh: 她每周用两次泥膜来控制多余油脂。

entries.shortAnswer: face mask 的中文意思是面膜，指敷在脸上的护肤产品。与 sheet mask（片状面膜）相比，face mask 是更宽泛的上位词，可包括泥膜、涂抹式面膜。
entries.definition: face mask 是常见护肤名词，口语和书面均可。搭配 apply/wear/use a face mask；注意不要与 medical mask（医用口罩）混淆，后者更常指防护口罩。

examples.en: After a long week, I like to apply a hydrating face mask and relax at home.
examples.zh: 忙了一周后，我喜欢敷一张补水面膜，在家放松一下。

examples.en: She uses a clay face mask twice a week to control excess oil.
examples.zh: 她每周用两次泥膜来控制多余油脂。

entries.shortAnswer: 染发就是 hair dyeing，指用染发剂把头发染成另一种颜色，不是指染发剂本身。
entries.definition: hair dyeing 指改变头发颜色的过程，染发剂叫 hair dye。常见搭配 salon hair dyeing、at-home hair dyeing，与漂发不同。

examples.en: She spends hours on hair dyeing every few months to keep her red color.
examples.zh: 她每隔几个月就要花好几个小时染发，以保持红色。

examples.en: At-home hair dyeing can save money but often gives uneven results.
examples.zh: 在家染发能省钱，但常常导致颜色不均匀。

entries.shortAnswer: Hair dyeing means 染发: coloring hair with dye, not the product itself.
entries.definition: Hair dyeing is the act of coloring hair with dye; the product is hair dye. Common in salon and at-home use, unlike bleaching.

examples.en: She spends hours on hair dyeing every few months to keep her red color.
examples.zh: 她每隔几个月就要花好几个小时染发，以保持红色。

examples.en: At-home hair dyeing can save money but often gives uneven results.
examples.zh: 在家染发能省钱，但常常导致颜色不均匀。

entries.shortAnswer: 「减肥餐」的英文是 diet meal，指为控制体重而设计的低热量餐食。注意 diet meal 强调一餐，不是长期节食 diet 本身。
entries.definition: diet meal 是可数名词，常搭配 eat/have/prepare a diet meal。它指一顿具体的减肥餐，如低卡沙拉或鸡胸肉餐；若泛指减肥饮食计划，英语更常说 diet 或 weight-loss diet。

examples.en: For lunch, she packed a simple diet meal with grilled chicken and steamed broccoli.
examples.zh: 午餐时，她带了一份简单的减肥餐，里面有烤鸡胸和蒸西兰花。

examples.en: He often skips dessert and orders a diet meal when eating out with friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友外出吃饭时，他常跳过甜点，点一份减肥餐。

entries.shortAnswer: diet meal 的中文意思是「减肥餐」，指为减重而控制热量的一餐。它与 diet 不同：diet meal 是具体的一顿饭，diet 可指整套饮食方案。
entries.definition: diet meal 是可数名词，常见搭配有 eat a diet meal、prepare diet meals。多用于日常口语和健康类文章，指低热量、低脂的一餐；若说「我在节食」通常用 I'm on a diet，而不是 I eat a diet meal。

examples.en: For lunch, she packed a simple diet meal with grilled chicken and steamed broccoli.
examples.zh: 午餐时，她带了一份简单的减肥餐，里面有烤鸡胸和蒸西兰花。

examples.en: He often skips dessert and orders a diet meal when eating out with friends.
examples.zh: 和朋友外出吃饭时，他常跳过甜点，点一份减肥餐。

entries.shortAnswer: 「腰围」的英文是 waistline；它指腰部最细处的围度，不是皮带位置，注意别和 waist（腰部区域）混用。
entries.definition: waistline 指天然腰线或衣物腰位，测腰围常说 measure your waistline、a slim waistline；美容健身语境谈身材线条，比 waist 更强调围度。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise and core work like crunches can help you trim your waistline.
examples.zh: 规律的有氧运动和卷腹等核心训练有助于缩小腰围。

examples.en: She measured her waistline before starting the stretching and warm-up routine.
examples.zh: 在开始拉伸和热身训练前，她量了自己的腰围。

entries.shortAnswer: waistline 的中文意思是「腰围」，也可指腰线；它强调腰部围度或衣物腰位，与泛指腰部的 waist 不同。
entries.definition: waistline 指腰部最细处的围度或衣物腰线，常见搭配 slim waistline、measure your waistline；健身谈身材时更常用，注意与 waist（腰部区域）区分。

examples.en: Regular aerobic exercise and core work like crunches can help you trim your waistline.
examples.zh: 规律的有氧运动和卷腹等核心训练有助于缩小腰围。

examples.en: She measured her waistline before starting the stretching and warm-up routine.
examples.zh: 在开始拉伸和热身训练前，她量了自己的腰围。

entries.shortAnswer: 「深蹲」的英文是 squat，既是名词也是动词。做力量训练说 do squats，口语中也可说 hit some squats，别和「拉伸」stretching 混用。
entries.definition: squat 指屈膝下蹲的健身动作，常搭配 do squats、bodyweight squat（徒手深蹲）、back squat（杠铃背蹲）。注意区分 squat 与 stretch：前者是力量动作，后者是拉伸热身，训练后肌肉酸痛称 DOMS。

examples.en: My trainer told me to do three sets of squats before moving on to push-ups.
examples.zh: 教练让我先做三组深蹲，然后再做俯卧撑。

examples.en: After leg day, my thighs were so sore that even a light squat hurt.
examples.zh: 练腿日之后，我的大腿酸得连轻轻蹲一下都疼。

entries.shortAnswer: Squat 的中文意思是「深蹲」，指屈膝下蹲再起身的健身动作。它和 push-up（俯卧撑）、crunch（卷腹）并列，属于常见力量训练，不是拉伸。
entries.definition: squat 作名词指深蹲这一动作，作动词指做深蹲，如 do squats、squat down。日常口语也可表示「蹲坐、擅自占用空屋」。健身语境常与 warm-up、muscle soreness、DOMS 同现，注意与 stretching 区分。

examples.en: My trainer told me to do three sets of squats before moving on to push-ups.
examples.zh: 教练让我先做三组深蹲，然后再做俯卧撑。

examples.en: After leg day, my thighs were so sore that even a light squat hurt.
examples.zh: 练腿日之后，我的大腿酸得连轻轻蹲一下都疼。

entries.shortAnswer: 「卡路里」的英文是 calorie，是食物能量与运动消耗的常用单位，日常多指大卡。
entries.definition: count calories 指计算卡路里、控制热量摄入；burn calories 指运动消耗热量；low-calorie 指低热量的。

examples.en: If you want to lose weight, you need to burn more calories than you take in.
examples.zh: 如果你想减肥，你需要消耗的卡路里比摄入的多。

examples.en: This sports drink claims to have only 50 calories per bottle, so it's a good choice after a workout.
examples.zh: 这款运动饮料声称每瓶只有50卡路里，所以是锻炼后的好选择。

entries.shortAnswer: Calorie 的中文意思是「卡路里」，指食物能量或运动消耗的单位，日常多等于千卡。
entries.definition: 常用搭配有 count calories、burn calories、low-calorie diet；营养标签和健身语境里 calorie 多指大卡。

examples.en: If you want to lose weight, you need to burn more calories than you take in.
examples.zh: 如果你想减肥，你需要消耗的卡路里比摄入的多。

examples.en: This sports drink claims to have only 50 calories per bottle, so it's a good choice after a workout.
examples.zh: 这款运动饮料声称每瓶只有50卡路里，所以是锻炼后的好选择。

entries.shortAnswer: 俯卧撑的英文是 push-up，指俯身撑起身体的徒手力量训练。注意它是无氧力量动作，别与热身的 warm-up 或拉伸 stretching 混为一谈。
entries.definition: push-up 是可数名词，复数 push-ups，常用搭配 do push-ups（做俯卧撑）、do 20 push-ups。它属无氧力量训练，练胸、肩、三头肌；注意与热身 warm-up 拼写和词义都不同，练后隔天酸痛多为 DOMS 迟发性肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: My trainer told me to do three sets of push-ups before moving on to squats.
examples.zh: 教练让我先做三组俯卧撑，再接着做深蹲。

examples.en: If regular push-ups are too hard, start on your knees and build up your strength.
examples.zh: 如果标准俯卧撑太难，可以先从跪姿做起，慢慢增强力量。

entries.shortAnswer: push-up 的中文意思是俯卧撑，一种俯身撑起身体的徒手力量训练动作。它是无氧力量练习，与热身 warm-up、拉伸 stretching 在拼写和含义上都不同。
entries.definition: push-up 为可数名词，常用 do push-ups 表示做俯卧撑，是练胸肌、肩部与三头肌的无氧力量动作，日常健身口语中极常见。易错点：不要与 warm-up（热身）混淆，训练后次日的肌肉酸痛称 DOMS 迟发性肌肉酸痛。

examples.en: My trainer told me to do three sets of push-ups before moving on to squats.
examples.zh: 教练让我先做三组俯卧撑，再接着做深蹲。

examples.en: If regular push-ups are too hard, start on your knees and build up your strength.
examples.zh: 如果标准俯卧撑太难，可以先从跪姿做起，慢慢增强力量。

entries.shortAnswer: 「体重秤」的英文是 bathroom scale。bathroom scale 特指家用人体秤，不是称食材的 kitchen scale。
entries.definition: bathroom scale 是名词，指放在浴室或卧室、用来称体重的小型秤。常见搭配：step on the bathroom scale（站上体重秤）、a digital bathroom scale（电子体重秤）。注意不要和 kitchen scale（厨房秤）混用。

examples.en: I weigh myself on the bathroom scale every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨早饭前都用体重秤称体重。

examples.en: This digital bathroom scale is more accurate than the old analog one.
examples.zh: 这台电子体重秤比旧的机械秤更准确。

entries.shortAnswer: bathroom scale 的中文意思是体重秤，特指家用称体重的秤。它和 kitchen scale（厨房秤）不同，后者用于称食材。
entries.definition: bathroom scale 指家用体重秤，常与 step on、digital、analog 等搭配。口语中也可简称 scale，但在需要区分时仍说 bathroom scale，以免与 kitchen scale 或 lab scale 混淆。

examples.en: I weigh myself on the bathroom scale every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 我每天早晨早饭前都用体重秤称体重。

examples.en: This digital bathroom scale is more accurate than the old analog one.
examples.zh: 这台电子体重秤比旧的机械秤更准确。

entries.shortAnswer: 有氧运动就是 aerobic exercise，比如跑步、游泳，能提升心率和耐力。
entries.definition: aerobic exercise 指有氧运动，靠氧气供能、持续时间长。常见搭配 do aerobic exercise。易混：与 anaerobic exercise 无氧运动相对。

examples.en: Doctors recommend at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic exercise per week to improve heart health.
examples.zh: 医生建议每周至少进行150分钟中等强度的有氧运动，以改善心脏健康。

examples.en: She does aerobic exercise every morning, but she also includes stretching to prevent muscle soreness.
examples.zh: 她每天早上做有氧运动，但也会加入拉伸来预防肌肉酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: aerobic exercise 就是“有氧运动”，如跑步、游泳，能提升心肺耐力。
entries.definition: aerobic exercise 指有氧运动，靠氧气持续供能，如慢跑、游泳。常用 do aerobic exercise，对比 anaerobic exercise。

examples.en: Doctors recommend at least 150 minutes of moderate aerobic exercise per week to improve heart health.
examples.zh: 医生建议每周至少进行150分钟中等强度的有氧运动，以改善心脏健康。

examples.en: She does aerobic exercise every morning, but she also includes stretching to prevent muscle soreness.
examples.zh: 她每天早上做有氧运动，但也会加入拉伸来预防肌肉酸痛。

entries.shortAnswer: 「增肌」的英文是 build muscle，指通过力量训练与合理营养来增加肌肉量。
entries.definition: build muscle 指通过抗阻力训练增加肌肉围度与力量，名词形式为 muscle building 或 muscle gain，口语也可说 put on muscle。

examples.en: To build muscle, you need to combine resistance training with enough protein and rest.
examples.zh: 要增肌，你需要将抗阻力训练与充足的蛋白质和休息结合起来。

examples.en: He lifted weights for a year to build muscle and tracked his progress closely.
examples.zh: 他举重一年来增肌，并密切记录自己的进展。

entries.shortAnswer: 「build muscle」的中文意思是「增肌」，即通过力量训练与合理饮食来增加肌肉量。
entries.definition: build muscle 指通过抗阻力训练刺激肌肉生长，常见搭配有 build muscle mass、build muscle fast，正式说法为 muscle hypertrophy。

examples.en: To build muscle, you need to combine resistance training with enough protein and rest.
examples.zh: 要增肌，你需要将抗阻力训练与充足的蛋白质和休息结合起来。

examples.en: He lifted weights for a year to build muscle and tracked his progress closely.
examples.zh: 他举重一年来增肌，并密切记录自己的进展。

entries.shortAnswer: 「无氧运动」的英文是 anaerobic exercise，指短时高强度的运动，如举重、短跑。
entries.definition: anaerobic exercise 指无氧运动，供氧不足下的短时高强度训练，如深蹲、短跑。常与有氧运动 aerobic exercise 相对。

examples.en: Sprinting and heavy weightlifting are classic examples of anaerobic exercise.
examples.zh: 短跑和大重量举重是无氧运动的典型例子。

examples.en: If you want to build muscle, add anaerobic exercise like squats and push-ups to your routine.
examples.zh: 如果你想增肌，可以在日常训练中加入深蹲和俯卧撑等无氧运动。

entries.shortAnswer: Anaerobic exercise means 无氧运动 in Chinese: short, intense activity like sprinting or weightlifting.
entries.definition: Anaerobic exercise is 无氧运动: brief, high-intensity training without enough oxygen, such as sprinting or lifting.

examples.en: Sprinting and heavy weightlifting are classic examples of anaerobic exercise.
examples.zh: 短跑和大重量举重是无氧运动的典型例子。

examples.en: If you want to build muscle, add anaerobic exercise like squats and push-ups to your routine.
examples.zh: 如果你想增肌，可以在日常训练中加入深蹲和俯卧撑等无氧运动。

entries.shortAnswer: 「养猫」的英文是 keep a cat，强调长期饲养并照料。注意口语中更常说 have a cat 表示家里有猫；追问日常照顾时才用 keep a cat 突出照顾责任。
entries.definition: keep a cat 指把猫作为宠物长期饲养、负责其饮食健康，比 have a cat 更强调照料责任。常见搭配：keep a cat indoors（室内养猫）、keep a cat as a pet。若指短暂收留应说 foster a cat（寄养/代养），不要用 keep。

examples.en: My landlord doesn't allow tenants to keep a cat, so I'm looking for a pet-friendly apartment.
examples.zh: 我的房东不允许租客养猫，所以我正在找可以养宠物的公寓。

examples.en: If you decide to keep a cat, remember to budget for cat litter, deworming, and regular vet visits.
examples.zh: 如果你决定养猫，记得把猫砂、驱虫和定期看兽医的费用算进预算。

entries.shortAnswer: keep a cat 的中文意思是「养猫」，指长期饲养并照顾一只猫。它比 have a cat 更强调照料责任；have a cat 只是说家里有猫。
entries.definition: keep a cat 意为把猫当宠物长期饲养并负责其生活，中性偏正式，常见于书面或认真讨论养宠责任的场合。注意 keep 后接动物时强调饲养照料，接物品则常指保存；短暂收留用 foster a cat 而非 keep。

examples.en: My landlord doesn't allow tenants to keep a cat, so I'm looking for a pet-friendly apartment.
examples.zh: 我的房东不允许租客养猫，所以我正在找可以养宠物的公寓。

examples.en: If you decide to keep a cat, remember to budget for cat litter, deworming, and regular vet visits.
examples.zh: 如果你决定养猫，记得把猫砂、驱虫和定期看兽医的费用算进预算。

entries.shortAnswer: 卷腹的英文是 crunch，指仰卧屈膝、靠腹肌收缩抬起上背的核心训练动作，注意与 sit-up 区分。
entries.definition: crunch 常用复数 crunches，如 do crunches、bicycle crunch。它主要练腹直肌，与 squat、push-up 常同组训练；练后酸胀多为 DOMS。

examples.en: I do three sets of crunches after my warm-up, then move on to squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 热身之后我做三组卷腹，然后接着做深蹲和俯卧撑。

examples.en: If your lower back hurts during crunches, you're probably pulling with your hip flexors instead of your abs.
examples.zh: 如果做卷腹时下背疼，你很可能是在用髋屈肌发力，而不是腹肌。

entries.shortAnswer: Crunch 的中文是卷腹，即仰卧屈膝、用腹肌把上背卷离地面的核心动作，与 sit-up 不同。
entries.definition: crunch 指卷腹动作，常用复数 crunches，搭配 do crunches、bicycle crunch；属腹肌孤立训练，常与 squat、push-up 并列。

examples.en: I do three sets of crunches after my warm-up, then move on to squats and push-ups.
examples.zh: 热身之后我做三组卷腹，然后接着做深蹲和俯卧撑。

examples.en: If your lower back hurts during crunches, you're probably pulling with your hip flexors instead of your abs.
examples.zh: 如果做卷腹时下背疼，你很可能是在用髋屈肌发力，而不是腹肌。

entries.shortAnswer: 「养狗」的英文是 keep a dog，强调长期饲养、照料一只狗。注意 keep a dog 侧重饲养状态，若要表达把狗带回家这件事，常说 get a dog 或 adopt a dog（领养）。
entries.definition: keep a dog 是英式、较传统的说法，美式口语更常直接说 have a dog。养狗涉及日常遛狗 walk the dog、定期驱虫 deworming、掉毛 shedding，以及公犬 neuter、母犬 spay 的绝育处理。

examples.en: My grandparents keep a dog and walk it in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我祖父母养了一只狗，每天早上都带它去公园遛。

examples.en: It takes time and money to keep a dog, so think carefully before you adopt one.
examples.zh: 养狗需要时间和金钱，所以在领养之前要仔细考虑。

entries.shortAnswer: “keep a dog”的中文意思是「养狗」，指长期饲养并照料一只狗。“keep”强调持续的饲养状态，比“buy a dog”更侧重日常照料，而不是购买这个动作。
entries.definition: keep a dog 意为饲养、照料一只狗，常见于英式英语；美式口语多用 have a dog。注意区分：养狗是 keep/have a dog，领养是 adopt a dog，把狗带回家是 get a dog，不要一律用 buy。

examples.en: My grandparents keep a dog and walk it in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我祖父母养了一只狗，每天早上都带它去公园遛。

examples.en: It takes time and money to keep a dog, so think carefully before you adopt one.
examples.zh: 养狗需要时间和金钱，所以在领养之前要仔细考虑。

entries.shortAnswer: 体脂率的英文是 body fat percentage，指脂肪占体重的百分比，健身中常说要降低体脂率。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：measure/calculate body fat percentage、healthy body fat percentage。易错点：别与BMI混为一谈。

examples.en: My personal trainer told me to measure my body fat percentage every month to track my progress.
examples.zh: 我的私人教练让我每个月测量一次体脂率，以跟踪我的进展。

examples.en: Doing both aerobic exercise and strength training can help lower your body fat percentage more effectively.
examples.zh: 同时进行有氧运动和力量训练可以更有效地降低你的体脂率。

entries.shortAnswer: Body fat percentage 的中文是体脂率，即脂肪占体重的比例，健身中常用它衡量胖瘦。
entries.definition: 核心词义：脂肪占体重的百分比。常见搭配：measure/calculate/track body fat percentage。易错点：注意区分BMI。

examples.en: My personal trainer told me to measure my body fat percentage every month to track my progress.
examples.zh: 我的私人教练让我每个月测量一次体脂率，以跟踪我的进展。

examples.en: Doing both aerobic exercise and strength training can help lower your body fat percentage more effectively.
examples.zh: 同时进行有氧运动和力量训练可以更有效地降低你的体脂率。

entries.shortAnswer: 狗粮的英文是 dog food，泛指供犬类食用的成品饲料。注意 dog food 是犬用食品，猫粮是 cat food，别在宠物店把两者混用。
entries.definition: dog food 指商业犬粮或犬类日常食物，搭配如 dry dog food（干粮）、wet dog food（湿粮）。口语里也可说 dog chow，但较随意；给狗喂食用 feed the dog。

examples.en: We buy grain-free dog food because our dog has sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 我们买无谷狗粮，因为我们的狗皮肤敏感。

examples.en: Remember to store the dog food in an airtight container to keep it fresh.
examples.zh: 记得把狗粮存放在密封容器里以保持新鲜。

entries.shortAnswer: Dog food 中文意思是“狗粮”，即专门给狗吃的商业饲料。它与 people food、table scraps 不同，特指犬类配方食品。
entries.definition: dog food 为不可数名词，常见搭配 dry/wet/canned dog food、premium dog food。口语可用 dog chow，但略随意；正式场合或兽医语境用 dog food。

examples.en: We buy grain-free dog food because our dog has sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 我们买无谷狗粮，因为我们的狗皮肤敏感。

examples.en: Remember to store the dog food in an airtight container to keep it fresh.
examples.zh: 记得把狗粮存放在密封容器里以保持新鲜。

entries.shortAnswer: 「遛狗」的英文是 walk the dog，指带狗出门散步。注意 walk the dog 是固定搭配，不能只说 walk dog，且遛狗通常隐含让狗排泄、活动，不同于单纯带狗出门。
entries.definition: walk the dog 是日常口语常用表达，强调带狗出去散步并让它排泄。也可说 take the dog for a walk，但 walk the dog 更简洁。注意区分 walk dog（错误）和 walk a dog（泛指遛一只狗）。

examples.en: I need to walk the dog before it gets dark.
examples.zh: 我得在天黑前遛狗。

examples.en: She walks the dog every morning in the park.
examples.zh: 她每天早上在公园遛狗。

entries.shortAnswer: 「walk the dog」的中文意思是「遛狗」，即带狗出门散步。它强调日常遛狗活动，通常包含让狗排泄；与 take the dog for a walk 同义，但更口语化。
entries.definition: walk the dog 是固定短语，意为带狗出去散步，常见于日常对话。注意不能说 walk dog，必须加冠词或限定词。与 walk a dog 相比，walk the dog 特指遛自家或特定的狗。

examples.en: I need to walk the dog before it gets dark.
examples.zh: 我得在天黑前遛狗。

examples.en: She walks the dog every morning in the park.
examples.zh: 她每天早上在公园遛狗。

entries.shortAnswer: 「猫粮」英文说 cat food，指专门给猫吃的市售干粮或湿粮，也可泛指喂猫的食物。
entries.definition: cat food 多作不可数名词，如 a bag of cat food。常见搭配：dry cat food（干粮）、wet cat food（湿粮）。

examples.en: I need to buy cat food on the way home because we ran out this morning.
examples.zh: 我下班路上得买猫粮，今天早上就吃完了。

examples.en: She mixes a little warm water into the dry cat food for her old cat.
examples.zh: 她会往干猫粮里兑一点温水，给她那只老猫吃。

entries.shortAnswer: Cat food is 「猫粮」 in Chinese: commercially made dry or wet food for cats, or food fed to cats.
entries.definition: Cat food is uncountable: a bag of cat food. Types include dry cat food and wet cat food; kitten food is for young cats.

examples.en: I need to buy cat food on the way home because we ran out this morning.
examples.zh: 我下班路上得买猫粮，今天早上就吃完了。

examples.en: She mixes a little warm water into the dry cat food for her old cat.
examples.zh: 她会往干猫粮里兑一点温水，给她那只老猫吃。

entries.shortAnswer: 「驱虫」英文是 deworming，常指给宠物清除体内寄生虫，别和体外驱虫混淆。
entries.definition: deworming 是名词/动名词，如 do deworming、regular deworming；动词用 deworm，如 deworm the dog。

examples.en: The vet said we should bring the puppy in for deworming every month until it's six months old.
examples.zh: 兽医说我们应该每月带小狗去做驱虫，直到它六个月大。

examples.en: Regular deworming is just as important as walking the dog and keeping up with its vaccinations.
examples.zh: 定期驱虫和遛狗、按时接种疫苗一样重要。

entries.shortAnswer: Deworming means 「驱虫」 in Chinese: giving pets medicine to clear internal parasites.
entries.definition: Deworming: giving pets medicine to kill intestinal worms. Say routine deworming or deworming schedule; for fleas use flea treatment.

examples.en: The vet said we should bring the puppy in for deworming every month until it's six months old.
examples.zh: 兽医说我们应该每月带小狗去做驱虫，直到它六个月大。

examples.en: Regular deworming is just as important as walking the dog and keeping up with its vaccinations.
examples.zh: 定期驱虫和遛狗、按时接种疫苗一样重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 宠物医院的英文是 vet clinic，指给猫狗等宠物看病的诊所。口语里也常说 vet 或 animal clinic，日常更常用 vet。
entries.definition: vet clinic 是通用说法，英式英语中也写 veterinary clinic。想去给宠物看病可说 take the pet to the vet clinic；注意 vet 在口语里也可直接指兽医本人，如 go to the vet 常省略 clinic。

examples.en: I need to take my cat to the vet clinic because she has been sneezing all week.
examples.zh: 我得带我的猫去宠物医院，因为它已经打了一周喷嚏了。

examples.en: The vet clinic near our apartment also offers pet boarding and deworming services.
examples.zh: 我们公寓附近的宠物医院还提供寄养和驱虫服务。

entries.shortAnswer: vet clinic 的中文意思是宠物医院，即给猫狗等宠物诊疗的诊所。它侧重诊疗机构本身，口语中常简称为 the vet。
entries.definition: vet clinic 指诊治宠物的诊所，常见搭配有 take the dog to the vet clinic、at the vet clinic。口语里 the vet 既可指诊所也可指兽医本人，动物收容所用的 animal clinic 偏机构化，不强调宠物主人视角。

examples.en: I need to take my cat to the vet clinic because she has been sneezing all week.
examples.zh: 我得带我的猫去宠物医院，因为它已经打了一周喷嚏了。

examples.en: The vet clinic near our apartment also offers pet boarding and deworming services.
examples.zh: 我们公寓附近的宠物医院还提供寄养和驱虫服务。

entries.shortAnswer: 「铲屎」英文说 scoop the litter，就是清理猫砂盆里的猫砂，是养猫的日常。
entries.definition: 铲屎指用铲子清理猫砂盆，英文说 scoop the litter 或 scoop the litter box。litter 在此指猫砂，不是垃圾。

examples.en: I scoop the litter every morning before work.
examples.zh: 我每天早上上班前都得铲屎。

examples.en: She jokes that she is a litter scoop officer, but she just loves scooping the litter for her three cats.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说自己是铲屎官，其实只是喜欢给三只猫铲屎。

entries.shortAnswer: Scoop the litter is 铲屎 in Chinese: cleaning a cat's litter box, a daily cat-care task.
entries.definition: Scoop the litter means to clean a cat's litter box with a scoop. In Chinese, 铲屎 is the everyday term for this cat-care task.

examples.en: I scoop the litter every morning before work.
examples.zh: 我每天早上上班前都得铲屎。

examples.en: She jokes that she is a litter scoop officer, but she just loves scooping the litter for her three cats.
examples.zh: 她开玩笑说自己是铲屎官，其实只是喜欢给三只猫铲屎。

entries.shortAnswer: 绝育在英文中常说 pet neutering，公畜用 neuter，母畜用 spay。
entries.definition: pet neutering 指为宠物做绝育手术的正式说法；日常也说 get the dog neutered 或 get the cat spayed。

examples.en: The vet recommended pet neutering before the dog reaches sexual maturity.
examples.zh: 兽医建议在狗狗达到性成熟之前进行绝育。

examples.en: Many animal shelters require pet neutering as part of the adoption process.
examples.zh: 许多动物收容所要求把绝育作为领养流程的一部分。

entries.shortAnswer: Pet neutering means 绝育, the general term for sterilizing pets; neuter males, spay females.
entries.definition: Pet neutering is the medical term for sterilizing a pet; use neuter for males and spay for females.

examples.en: The vet recommended pet neutering before the dog reaches sexual maturity.
examples.zh: 兽医建议在狗狗达到性成熟之前进行绝育。

examples.en: Many animal shelters require pet neutering as part of the adoption process.
examples.zh: 许多动物收容所要求把绝育作为领养流程的一部分。

entries.shortAnswer: 「挠沙发」的英文是 scratch the sofa，指宠物用爪子抓沙发。注意搭配是 scratch the sofa，不要说成 scratch on the sofa。
entries.definition: scratch 作及物动词，后面直接接被挠的东西：scratch the sofa、scratch the door、scratch the furniture。多用来描述猫磨爪、狗刨抓家具的破坏行为，常和 stop、prevent 连用。

examples.en: My cat loves to scratch the sofa, so I bought her a scratching post.
examples.zh: 我家猫特别爱挠沙发，所以我给它买了个猫抓板。

examples.en: If your dog starts to scratch the sofa, redirect it to a chew toy right away.
examples.zh: 如果你的狗开始挠沙发，要立刻把它引到咬胶玩具上。

entries.shortAnswer: scratch the sofa 的中文意思是「挠沙发」，指猫狗用爪子抓挠沙发。和 claw at the sofa 强调反复抓扒不同，scratch the sofa 更强调留下抓痕。
entries.definition: scratch the sofa 为及物动词搭配，scratch 后直接跟名词，不接 on。多用于宠物话题，描述猫磨爪或狗刨抓家具的行为，常与 stop、keep the cat from 搭配。

examples.en: My cat loves to scratch the sofa, so I bought her a scratching post.
examples.zh: 我家猫特别爱挠沙发，所以我给它买了个猫抓板。

examples.en: If your dog starts to scratch the sofa, redirect it to a chew toy right away.
examples.zh: 如果你的狗开始挠沙发，要立刻把它引到咬胶玩具上。

entries.shortAnswer: 宠物美容的英文是 pet grooming，指给猫狗洗澡、修剪毛发和指甲等日常护理。
entries.definition: pet grooming 是名词短语，指宠物清洁与外观护理，包括洗澡、剪毛、剪指甲、清耳道等，动词用 groom a pet。

examples.en: I take my dog for pet grooming every two months to keep his coat clean and mat-free.
examples.zh: 我每两个月带我的狗去做一次宠物美容，保持毛发干净不打结。

examples.en: Pet grooming usually includes bathing, brushing, nail clipping, and ear cleaning.
examples.zh: 宠物美容通常包括洗澡、梳毛、剪指甲和清洁耳朵。

entries.shortAnswer: 宠物美容的英文是 pet grooming，指给宠物洗澡、修剪毛发和指甲等护理。
entries.definition: pet grooming 指宠物美容护理，常见搭配有 dog grooming、grooming salon，动词形式是 groom a dog。

examples.en: I take my dog for pet grooming every two months to keep his coat clean and mat-free.
examples.zh: 我每两个月带我的狗去做一次宠物美容，保持毛发干净不打结。

examples.en: Pet grooming usually includes bathing, brushing, nail clipping, and ear cleaning.
examples.zh: 宠物美容通常包括洗澡、梳毛、剪指甲和清洁耳朵。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拴狗绳」的英文是 dog leash。在美式英语中常用 leash，英式英语更常说 lead，如 walk the dog on a leash（用狗绳遛狗），别把它误说成 dog rope。
entries.definition: dog leash 是可数名词，常搭配 put on / take off the leash、keep the dog on a leash；公共场合需 leash your dog（给狗拴绳）。英式英语常用 lead 替代 leash，而 rope 不指牵狗绳。

examples.en: Always keep your dog on a dog leash when walking in the park.
examples.zh: 在公园遛狗时，务必用拴狗绳牵好你的狗。

examples.en: She bought a new dog leash and collar before adopting the puppy.
examples.zh: 她在领养那只小狗之前，买了一条新拴狗绳和项圈。

entries.shortAnswer: dog leash 的中文意思是「拴狗绳」。它专指遛狗时系在项圈上的牵绳，与 dog collar（项圈）不同，前者是牵绳，后者戴在脖子上。
entries.definition: dog leash 在美式英语中很常见，指遛狗用的牵绳；英式英语常用 lead。常见搭配：on a leash、keep the dog on a leash、leash laws（牵绳法规）。注意不要与 collar（项圈）混淆。

examples.en: Always keep your dog on a dog leash when walking in the park.
examples.zh: 在公园遛狗时，务必用拴狗绳牵好你的狗。

examples.en: She bought a new dog leash and collar before adopting the puppy.
examples.zh: 她在领养那只小狗之前，买了一条新拴狗绳和项圈。

entries.shortAnswer: 「流浪猫」的英文是 stray cat。它指在街头无人饲养的猫，和野性更强的 feral cat 不同，stray 更接近走失或被遗弃的家猫。
entries.definition: stray cat 是名词短语，泛指在社区、街头活动的无主猫；stray 强调曾被人养过、可能亲近人，feral cat 则指野化、远离人类的猫。相关说法还有 community cat（社区猫），领养时常用 adopt a stray cat，而不是 buy。

examples.en: She adopted a stray cat from the shelter and named it Momo.
examples.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只流浪猫，给它取名默默。

examples.en: We feed a few stray cats near the office every evening after walking the dog.
examples.zh: 我们每天傍晚遛完狗后，都会去喂办公楼附近的几只流浪猫。

entries.shortAnswer: A stray cat in Chinese means 流浪猫，即无家可归、在街头活动的猫。和 feral cat 不同，stray 通常指走失或被遗弃、仍可能亲近人的家猫。
entries.definition: Stray cat 是可数名词短语，指离开主人、在街头或社区流浪的猫；常搭配 feed a stray cat、take in a stray cat、rescue a stray cat。它偏日常口语，正式语境也常用；注意不要说 wild cat，那多指野生的猫科动物。

examples.en: She adopted a stray cat from the shelter and named it Momo.
examples.zh: 她从收容所领养了一只流浪猫，给它取名默默。

examples.en: We feed a few stray cats near the office every evening after walking the dog.
examples.zh: 我们每天傍晚遛完狗后，都会去喂办公楼附近的几只流浪猫。

entries.shortAnswer: 「掉毛」的英文是 shedding，指宠物正常换毛或异常脱毛；动词用 shed，别说 lose hair。
entries.definition: shedding 指猫狗等动物自然脱落毛发或换毛过程。常见搭配：excessive shedding、reduce shedding，口语也说 shed a lot。正常换毛用 shedding，皮肤病局部脱毛多用 hair loss。

examples.en: My dog's shedding gets much worse in spring, so I brush him every day.
examples.zh: 我的狗春天掉毛严重得多，所以我每天给它梳毛。

examples.en: Regular grooming can help reduce shedding and keep your cat's coat healthy.
examples.zh: 定期梳理有助于减少掉毛，并让猫咪的毛发保持健康。

entries.shortAnswer: Shedding 的中文意思是「掉毛」，指猫狗自然掉毛或换毛；多属正常生理现象，异常脱毛常用 hair loss。
entries.definition: shedding 是名词，指动物周期性脱落毛发；动词为 shed，如 Dogs shed in spring。常见搭配：excessive shedding、shedding season。描述人脱发一般用 hair loss，不用 shedding。

examples.en: My dog's shedding gets much worse in spring, so I brush him every day.
examples.zh: 我的狗春天掉毛严重得多，所以我每天给它梳毛。

examples.en: Regular grooming can help reduce shedding and keep your cat's coat healthy.
examples.zh: 定期梳理有助于减少掉毛，并让猫咪的毛发保持健康。

entries.shortAnswer: 「领养」的英文是 adopt a pet，强调从收容所或救助机构把动物带回家；如果是领养小孩，直接用 adopt，不加 a pet。
entries.definition: adopt a pet 指从收容所、救助站领养宠物，而不是花钱购买（buy）。口语也可说 adopt a dog/cat。注意 adopt 后接人时是「收养」，接宠物才是「领养」，两者含义不同。

examples.en: We decided to adopt a pet from the local shelter instead of buying one from a breeder.
examples.zh: 我们决定从当地收容所领养一只宠物，而不是从繁殖者那里购买。

examples.en: Before you adopt a pet, make sure you can afford food, vet visits, and deworming.
examples.zh: 在领养宠物之前，要确保你负担得起食物、看兽医和驱虫的费用。

entries.shortAnswer: adopt a pet 的中文意思是「领养」，指从收容所或救助机构把动物带回家饲养，而不是购买；只用于动物，收养小孩则说 adopt a child。
entries.definition: adopt a pet 指通过正规机构领养宠物，常与 from a shelter 连用。名称为 adoption。与 buy a pet 相对，强调救助而非买卖，多用于公益、动保语境，也可口语泛指养宠物。

examples.en: We decided to adopt a pet from the local shelter instead of buying one from a breeder.
examples.zh: 我们决定从当地收容所领养一只宠物，而不是从繁殖者那里购买。

examples.en: Before you adopt a pet, make sure you can afford food, vet visits, and deworming.
examples.zh: 在领养宠物之前，要确保你负担得起食物、看兽医和驱虫的费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「狗叫」的英文是 dog barking，指狗发出的吠叫声，也可说 the dog is barking。
entries.definition: dog barking 指狗的吠叫声，如 the dog barking next door；单数 a bark 指一声犬吠。表示动作时常用动词 bark：The dog barks at strangers。

examples.en: The dog barking next door kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 隔壁的狗叫声让我整夜没睡着。

examples.en: Our neighbor complained about the dog barking while we were away.
examples.zh: 我们外出时，邻居抱怨狗一直叫。

entries.shortAnswer: Dog barking 的中文意思是「狗叫」，即狗发出的吠叫声；单数 a bark 指一声短促的犬吠。
entries.definition: dog barking 指狗叫的声音或行为，如 Dog barking can be annoying at night；表示具体动作时常用动词 bark：The dog barks at the mailman。

examples.en: The dog barking next door kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 隔壁的狗叫声让我整夜没睡着。

examples.en: Our neighbor complained about the dog barking while we were away.
examples.zh: 我们外出时，邻居抱怨狗一直叫。

entries.shortAnswer: 「撸猫」的英文是 petting a cat，指用手轻抚逗弄猫咪，常带治愈解压的意味。
entries.definition: petting a cat 指用手抚摸猫的动作，口语也说 petting my cat。中文撸猫语义更宽，常带吸猫、解压意味。

examples.en: After a long day at work, I love petting a cat on the sofa to relax.
examples.zh: 工作一整天后，我喜欢在沙发上撸猫放松。

examples.en: She spends every evening petting a cat while watching videos to unwind.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都一边撸猫一边看视频来放松。

entries.shortAnswer: Petting a cat means 撸猫 in Chinese: stroking and gently playing with a cat for comfort.
entries.definition: Petting a cat is the everyday phrase for stroking a cat by hand. It can also suggest relaxing with cats, like 撸猫 in Chinese.

examples.en: After a long day at work, I love petting a cat on the sofa to relax.
examples.zh: 工作一整天后，我喜欢在沙发上撸猫放松。

examples.en: She spends every evening petting a cat while watching videos to unwind.
examples.zh: 她每天晚上都一边撸猫一边看视频来放松。

entries.shortAnswer: 「流浪狗」的英文是 stray dog，指无主流落街头的狗。注意 stray 强调“走失、无主”，家养走失的宠物狗也可说 lost dog。
entries.definition: stray dog 是通用说法，中性偏书面；口语常说 a dog with no home。流浪狗常被收容所 rescue 后供人 adopt 领养，而非 buy 购买。

examples.en: She adopted a stray dog from the shelter last month.
examples.zh: 她上个月从收容所领养了一只流浪狗。

examples.en: Every evening he feeds the stray dogs near his apartment.
examples.zh: 他每天傍晚都在公寓附近喂那些流浪狗。

entries.shortAnswer: stray dog 的中文意思是「流浪狗」，指无主流浪街头的狗。它强调无主状态，而 lost dog 侧重走失、可能仍有主人寻找。
entries.definition: stray dog 为通用表达，可指野犬或走失犬。常见搭配：adopt a stray dog（领养）、feed a stray dog（投喂）。正式语境用 homeless dog，口语说 a dog on the street。

examples.en: She adopted a stray dog from the shelter last month.
examples.zh: 她上个月从收容所领养了一只流浪狗。

examples.en: Every evening he feeds the stray dogs near his apartment.
examples.zh: 他每天傍晚都在公寓附近喂那些流浪狗。

entries.shortAnswer: 寄养在英语中常说 pet boarding，指主人外出时把宠物送到机构或他人家中短期照料。
entries.definition: pet boarding 是名词，指宠物短期寄养服务，如 boarding kennel、boarding fee。注意与 permanent adoption 区分。

examples.en: We use pet boarding whenever we travel abroad, because our cat hates staying alone.
examples.zh: 我们每次出国旅行都把猫送去寄养，因为它不喜欢独自待着。

examples.en: Good pet boarding facilities require proof of vaccination before accepting your dog.
examples.zh: 好的寄养机构在接受你的狗之前会要求提供疫苗接种证明。

entries.shortAnswer: Pet boarding is 寄养 in Chinese: temporary paid care for pets while owners are away.
entries.definition: Pet boarding is a noun for short-term paid pet care away from home, as in boarding kennel or boarding fee. It differs from adoption.

examples.en: We use pet boarding whenever we travel abroad, because our cat hates staying alone.
examples.zh: 我们每次出国旅行都把猫送去寄养，因为它不喜欢独自待着。

examples.en: Good pet boarding facilities require proof of vaccination before accepting your dog.
examples.zh: 好的寄养机构在接受你的狗之前会要求提供疫苗接种证明。

entries.shortAnswer: 「逗猫棒」的英文是 cat teaser，口语也说 cat wand 或 feather wand。
entries.definition: cat teaser 指带羽毛或小玩具的杆子，用来逗猫扑咬，常搭配 play with a cat teaser。

examples.en: My cat goes crazy whenever I pick up the cat teaser.
examples.zh: 我一拿起逗猫棒，我家猫就疯了。

examples.en: She waved the cat teaser slowly to let the kitten catch it.
examples.zh: 她慢慢挥动逗猫棒，让小猫能抓住它。

entries.shortAnswer: The Chinese word 逗猫棒 means cat teaser, a wand used to play with cats.
entries.definition: A cat teaser is a wand with feathers or a toy, used to play with cats. Not the same as cat toy.

examples.en: My cat goes crazy whenever I pick up the cat teaser.
examples.zh: 我一拿起逗猫棒，我家猫就疯了。

examples.en: She waved the cat teaser slowly to let the kitten catch it.
examples.zh: 她慢慢挥动逗猫棒，让小猫能抓住它。

entries.shortAnswer: 「狗窝」的英文是 dog kennel。日常口语也常说 dog house，但 dog kennel 更常指专门建造或商业寄养的犬舍，dog house 多指院子里的小木屋。
entries.definition: dog kennel 指狗睡觉或临时关养的小屋，也可指宠物寄养机构。家里给狗买的室内软窝一般说 dog bed，而户外木制狗屋、繁殖或寄养犬舍才用 dog kennel。

examples.en: We built a wooden dog kennel in the backyard so our dog can rest outside during the day.
examples.zh: 我们在后院建了一个木制狗窝，这样白天狗可以在外面休息。

examples.en: When we travel, we leave our dog at a boarding kennel that provides daily walks and feeding.
examples.zh: 我们旅行时，会把狗送到提供每日遛狗和喂食的寄养狗舍。

entries.shortAnswer: dog kennel 的中文意思是「狗窝」，指狗睡觉或暂住的小屋。它和 dog house 都可指狗屋，但 kennel 更常指专业繁殖或寄养犬舍，dog house 多指院子里的小木屋。
entries.definition: dog kennel 作名词指狗舍、狗窝，也可指寄养或繁殖狗的场所。家庭场景常与 dog bed 区分：kennel 偏户外或商业。常见搭配有 boarding kennel（寄养犬舍）和 kennel cough（犬窝咳）。

examples.en: We built a wooden dog kennel in the backyard so our dog can rest outside during the day.
examples.zh: 我们在后院建了一个木制狗窝，这样白天狗可以在外面休息。

examples.en: When we travel, we leave our dog at a boarding kennel that provides daily walks and feeding.
examples.zh: 我们旅行时，会把狗送到提供每日遛狗和喂食的寄养狗舍。

entries.shortAnswer: 「宠物保险」的英文是 pet insurance，指为猫狗等宠物支付医疗或意外费用的保障。
entries.definition: pet insurance 是固定名词搭配，不可数，常说 buy pet insurance、pet insurance policy。口语也可说 insurance for pets。

examples.en: Before adopting a dog, you should look into pet insurance to cover unexpected vet bills.
examples.zh: 在领养狗之前，你应该了解宠物保险，以应对意外的兽医费用。

examples.en: Her cat needed surgery, but pet insurance covered most of the cost.
examples.zh: 她的猫需要手术，但宠物保险报销了大部分费用。

entries.shortAnswer: pet insurance 的中文意思是「宠物保险」，为宠物医疗、意外或手术费用提供保障。
entries.definition: pet insurance 是常用名词短语，常见搭配有 buy pet insurance、pet insurance policy。insurance 不可数，不能说 a pet insurance。

examples.en: Before adopting a dog, you should look into pet insurance to cover unexpected vet bills.
examples.zh: 在领养狗之前，你应该了解宠物保险，以应对意外的兽医费用。

examples.en: Her cat needed surgery, but pet insurance covered most of the cost.
examples.zh: 她的猫需要手术，但宠物保险报销了大部分费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「猫砂」的英文是 cat litter，指放在猫砂盆里供猫咪排泄用的颗粒状垫料。
entries.definition: cat litter 是宠物用品术语，口语中常省略 cat 直接说 litter，常见搭配有 clean the litter box、clumping cat litter。

examples.en: I need to buy more cat litter before the weekend, or my cat will make a mess.
examples.zh: 周末前我得再买些猫砂，不然我的猫会把家里弄得一团糟。

examples.en: She forgot to clean the cat litter, so the whole room smelled bad.
examples.zh: 她忘了清理猫砂，结果整个房间都很难闻。

entries.shortAnswer: Cat litter is 猫砂 in Chinese, the granular material placed in a litter box for cats to use.
entries.definition: Cat litter means 猫砂 in Chinese, absorbent pellets or clumping clay sold for use in a cat's litter box.

examples.en: I need to buy more cat litter before the weekend, or my cat will make a mess.
examples.zh: 周末前我得再买些猫砂，不然我的猫会把家里弄得一团糟。

examples.en: She forgot to clean the cat litter, so the whole room smelled bad.
examples.zh: 她忘了清理猫砂，结果整个房间都很难闻。

entries.shortAnswer: 仓鼠的英文是 hamster，指这种小型啮齿类宠物。注意别与 guinea pig（豚鼠）混用，hamster 更小、有颊囊。
entries.definition: hamster 是可数名词，指仓鼠。常见搭配：pet hamster（宠物仓鼠）、hamster cage（仓鼠笼）、hamster wheel（跑轮）。

examples.en: My daughter keeps a hamster in her bedroom and cleans its cage every weekend.
examples.zh: 我女儿在卧室里养了一只仓鼠，每个周末都清理它的笼子。

examples.en: The hamster runs on its wheel all night, so it is always sleeping during the day.
examples.zh: 仓鼠整晚都在跑轮上跑，所以白天总是在睡觉。

entries.shortAnswer: Hamster 的中文意思是仓鼠，一种常被当宠物养的小型啮齿动物。hamster 比 guinea pig（豚鼠）更小，爱跑跑轮。
entries.definition: Hamster 是可数名词，指仓鼠。常见搭配：pet hamster（宠物仓鼠）、hamster cage（仓鼠笼）、hamster wheel（跑轮）。

examples.en: My daughter keeps a hamster in her bedroom and cleans its cage every weekend.
examples.zh: 我女儿在卧室里养了一只仓鼠，每个周末都清理它的笼子。

examples.en: The hamster runs on its wheel all night, so it is always sleeping during the day.
examples.zh: 仓鼠整晚都在跑轮上跑，所以白天总是在睡觉。

entries.shortAnswer: 「快递单号」英文是 tracking number，也常说 tracking code，查物流最常用 tracking number。
entries.definition: tracking number 指包裹的唯一查询编号，可用于在快递官网追踪物流。常见搭配：enter/provide/check a tracking number。

examples.en: Could you please send me the tracking number so I can check where my parcel is?
examples.zh: 你能把快递单号发给我吗？这样我好查一下包裹到哪儿了。

examples.en: I entered the tracking number on the courier's website, but it says the parcel is still at customs clearance.
examples.zh: 我在快递公司网站上输入了快递单号，但显示包裹还在清关。

entries.shortAnswer: 「快递单号」in English is tracking number, the unique code for tracking a parcel.
entries.definition: A tracking number is a unique code from a carrier to trace a parcel. Common collocations: provide, enter, or check a tracking number.

examples.en: Could you please send me the tracking number so I can check where my parcel is?
examples.zh: 你能把快递单号发给我吗？这样我好查一下包裹到哪儿了。

examples.en: I entered the tracking number on the courier's website, but it says the parcel is still at customs clearance.
examples.zh: 我在快递公司网站上输入了快递单号，但显示包裹还在清关。

entries.shortAnswer: 驿站英文是 pickup station，指快递代收点，如菜鸟驿站。注意易错：欧美通常送货上门，没有中国这种先入站再凭码自提的普遍模式。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：菜鸟驿站 Cainiao pickup station、取件码 pickup code、凭码自提。易错点：pickup station 多指快递代收点，不是物流中转站或快递柜，后者叫 parcel locker。

examples.en: Your parcel has arrived at the pickup station; please collect it with your pickup code.
examples.zh: 您的快递已到驿站，请凭取件码领取。

examples.en: In China, many packages are delivered to a pickup station instead of your doorstep, so you need to pick them up yourself.
examples.zh: 在中国，很多包裹会被送到驿站而不是家门口，所以你需要自己去取。

entries.shortAnswer: Pickup station 中文意思是驿站，即快递代收点。关键区别：欧美快递多直投家门口，而中国快递常先放驿站再凭码自提，解决最后一百米。
entries.definition: 核心词义：快递代收点，如菜鸟驿站。搭配：pickup code、collect a parcel。场合：日常口语和快递通知。易错点：与 parcel locker 快递柜、物流中转站不同。

examples.en: Your parcel has arrived at the pickup station; please collect it with your pickup code.
examples.zh: 您的快递已到驿站，请凭取件码领取。

examples.en: In China, many packages are delivered to a pickup station instead of your doorstep, so you need to pick them up yourself.
examples.zh: 在中国，很多包裹会被送到驿站而不是家门口，所以你需要自己去取。

entries.shortAnswer: 「取快递」的英文是 pick up a package，指去快递点、快递柜或门卫处把包裹取走，别用 take 或 fetch。
entries.definition: pick up a package 最常用；英式也说 collect a parcel。到快递柜取件可说 pick it up from a parcel locker，代取用 pick up a package for someone。

examples.en: I need to pick up a package at the parcel locker before it closes.
examples.zh: 我得在快递柜关门前去取快递。

examples.en: Could you pick up a package for me at the delivery station? I'm still at work.
examples.zh: 你能帮我去快递驿站取个快递吗？我还在上班。

entries.shortAnswer: pick up a package 的意思是「取快递」，指本人去快递点、快递柜或前台把包裹拿走。
entries.definition: pick up a package 为日常口语，英式对应 collect a parcel。常见搭配：pick up a package from the parcel locker、pick up a package for a friend。

examples.en: I need to pick up a package at the parcel locker before it closes.
examples.zh: 我得在快递柜关门前去取快递。

examples.en: Could you pick up a package for me at the delivery station? I'm still at work.
examples.zh: 你能帮我去快递驿站取个快递吗？我还在上班。

entries.shortAnswer: 「快递柜」的英文是 parcel locker，指快递员存放包裹、收件人凭取件码自取的智能柜。
entries.definition: parcel locker 是名词，指快递员暂存包裹、收件人凭取件码自取的智能柜。常搭配：pick up a parcel from a parcel locker（从快递柜取件）。

examples.en: The courier left my package in the parcel locker because I wasn't home.
examples.zh: 快递员因为我没在家，把包裹放进了快递柜。

examples.en: Enter the pickup code to open the parcel locker and get your parcel.
examples.zh: 输入取件码即可打开快递柜取走包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: A parcel locker, known in Chinese as 快递柜, is an automated self-service cabinet for package pickup.
entries.definition: A parcel locker is a secure self-service cabinet where couriers deposit parcels for recipients to collect using a pickup code or key.

examples.en: The courier left my package in the parcel locker because I wasn't home.
examples.zh: 快递员因为我没在家，把包裹放进了快递柜。

examples.en: Enter the pickup code to open the parcel locker and get your parcel.
examples.zh: 输入取件码即可打开快递柜取走包裹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发货」的英文是 ship goods，指把货物交给快递或物流方寄出，ship 不限于海运。
entries.definition: ship goods 偏商务和跨境电商语境，也可说 send the package；相关词有 tracking number、shipping fee。

examples.en: We will ship goods within 24 hours after your payment is confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认付款后，我们会在二十四小时内发货。

examples.en: The seller forgot to ship goods and did not upload the tracking number.
examples.zh: 卖家忘了发货，也没有上传快递单号。

entries.shortAnswer: ship goods 的中文意思是「发货」，指把货物交给快递或物流公司寄出，偏商务语境。
entries.definition: ship goods 强调货物已交承运方发出，常用于外贸和电商；注意 deliver 指送达买方，ship 指发货。

examples.en: We will ship goods within 24 hours after your payment is confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认付款后，我们会在二十四小时内发货。

examples.en: The seller forgot to ship goods and did not upload the tracking number.
examples.zh: 卖家忘了发货，也没有上传快递单号。

entries.shortAnswer: 「拒收」英文是 reject a delivery，指收货人拒绝签收包裹，强调明确拒绝。
entries.definition: reject a delivery 用于快递场景，指收货人主动拒收包裹。也可说 refuse a delivery，但 reject 更正式。

examples.en: The customer decided to reject a delivery because the package was damaged.
examples.zh: 客户因为包裹破损决定拒收。

examples.en: If you reject a delivery, the courier will return it to the sender.
examples.zh: 如果你拒收，快递员会把包裹退回给寄件人。

entries.shortAnswer: “reject a delivery” means 拒收, refusing to accept a package upon delivery.
entries.definition: reject a delivery means refusing to accept a package when it arrives. It is more formal than refuse a delivery.

examples.en: The customer decided to reject a delivery because the package was damaged.
examples.zh: 客户因为包裹破损决定拒收。

examples.en: If you reject a delivery, the courier will return it to the sender.
examples.zh: 如果你拒收，快递员会把包裹退回给寄件人。

entries.shortAnswer: 「催单」的英文是 urge delivery，指催促快递或订单尽快发出或送达。它偏正式，口语里也常说 chase up the order 或 ask for faster delivery。
entries.definition: urge delivery 多用于催促卖家、客服或物流方加快发货或派送，常见搭配有 urge delivery of an order、urge the courier to deliver。注意它强调催「送达」，若只是催发货更常说 urge shipment。

examples.en: I called the seller to urge delivery because my parcel had been stuck at the sorting center for three days.
examples.zh: 我打电话给卖家催单，因为我的包裹在分拣中心滞留了三天。

examples.en: She emailed the courier company to urge delivery of the package before the weekend.
examples.zh: 她给快递公司发邮件催单，希望在周末前把包裹送到。

entries.shortAnswer: urge delivery 的中文意思是「催单」，即催促订单尽快发货或送达。它比 push the order 更正式，重点在催促物流环节而非单纯询问进度。
entries.definition: urge delivery 是动词短语，用于向卖家、客服或快递公司施压要求更快送货，常见搭配为 urge delivery of a parcel、urge the courier to deliver。多用于客服邮件等正式场合，口语中常用 chase up。

examples.en: I called the seller to urge delivery because my parcel had been stuck at the sorting center for three days.
examples.zh: 我打电话给卖家催单，因为我的包裹在分拣中心滞留了三天。

examples.en: She emailed the courier company to urge delivery of the package before the weekend.
examples.zh: 她给快递公司发邮件催单，希望在周末前把包裹送到。

entries.shortAnswer: 「运单」的英文是 waybill，指承运人签发的货物运输单据。注意与快递单号 tracking number 区分：waybill 是单据本身，单号只是其编号。
entries.definition: waybill 常用于空运、海运、快递等物流场景，如 air waybill（空运单）、express waybill（快递运单）。它记录发货人、收货人、货物明细与运费，是清关和丢件索赔的关键凭证；口语中人们更常说 tracking number 来指单号。

examples.en: Please keep the waybill in a safe place; you'll need it to claim compensation if the parcel is lost.
examples.zh: 请妥善保管运单，如果包裹丢失，你需要用它来申请赔偿。

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign the waybill before handing over the package.
examples.zh: 快递员让我在运单上签字后才把包裹交给我。

entries.shortAnswer: waybill 的中文意思是「运单」，是承运人签发的货物运输单据。它与 bill of lading 不同：waybill 通常不可转让，多见于空运和快递。
entries.definition: waybill 指随货运输单据，列明发货人、收货人、货物及运费，用于清关和追踪。常见搭配有 air waybill、express waybill。正式场合用 waybill，日常查件时人们更常说 tracking number 或 shipping label。

examples.en: Please keep the waybill in a safe place; you'll need it to claim compensation if the parcel is lost.
examples.zh: 请妥善保管运单，如果包裹丢失，你需要用它来申请赔偿。

examples.en: The courier asked me to sign the waybill before handing over the package.
examples.zh: 快递员让我在运单上签字后才把包裹交给我。

entries.shortAnswer: 「丢件」英文说 lost parcel，指包裹在运输途中丢失。注意它是名词短语，不能说 My parcel lost。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：report a lost parcel（报丢件）、a lost parcel claim（丢件索赔）、track a lost parcel（查丢件）。英式多用 lost parcel，美式常作 lost package。

examples.en: I contacted the courier because my lost parcel still hasn't been found after two weeks.
examples.zh: 我联系了快递公司，因为我的丢件已经两周了还没找到。

examples.en: To file a claim for a lost parcel, you need the tracking number and the shipping receipt.
examples.zh: 申请丢件索赔时，你需要提供快递单号和运费收据。

entries.shortAnswer: lost parcel 中文是「丢件」，指快递包裹在运输途中遗失，强调包裹整件丢失。
entries.definition: 快递物流常用说法，英式更常见，美式多用 lost package。搭配：report a lost parcel、file a lost parcel claim。

examples.en: I contacted the courier because my lost parcel still hasn't been found after two weeks.
examples.zh: 我联系了快递公司，因为我的丢件已经两周了还没找到。

examples.en: To file a claim for a lost parcel, you need the tracking number and the shipping receipt.
examples.zh: 申请丢件索赔时，你需要提供快递单号和运费收据。

entries.shortAnswer: 运费在英语中常说 shipping fee，指物流配送费。注意 shipping fee 多指卖家收取的配送费。
entries.definition: shipping fee 指物流配送费用，常见搭配 pay the shipping fee、free shipping fee。与 postage 不同，postage 侧重邮资，shipping fee 更泛指尖端电商或快递运费。

examples.en: The online store offers free shipping fee for orders over fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 这家网店对超过五十美元的订单免收运费。

examples.en: If you reject the delivery, the shipping fee may not be refunded.
examples.zh: 如果你拒收快递，运费可能不会退还。

entries.shortAnswer: shipping fee 的中文意思是运费，指物流配送费。与 delivery fee 相比，shipping fee 更侧重运输环节。
entries.definition: shipping fee 指寄送或配送商品时收取的运费，常见搭配 charge a shipping fee、waive the shipping fee。口语中也可说 shipping cost，正式场合多用 shipping fee。

examples.en: The online store offers free shipping fee for orders over fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 这家网店对超过五十美元的订单免收运费。

examples.en: If you reject the delivery, the shipping fee may not be refunded.
examples.zh: 如果你拒收快递，运费可能不会退还。

entries.shortAnswer: 「破损件」英文是 damaged parcel，指运输中外包装或内件受损的包裹，常用于理赔与客服沟通。
entries.definition: damaged parcel 指运输中受损的包裹，常见于理赔与客服场景，如 report a damaged parcel。

examples.en: I need to report a damaged parcel because the box was crushed and the contents were broken.
examples.zh: 我要申报一个破损件，因为箱子被压扁了，里面的东西也碎了。

examples.en: Please take photos of the damaged parcel and keep the tracking number for your claim.
examples.zh: 请给这个破损件拍照，并保留快递单号以便申请理赔。

entries.shortAnswer: Damaged parcel 中文叫「破损件」，指运输中受损的包裹，与丢件不同，常用于理赔场景。
entries.definition: Damaged parcel 指运输中受损的包裹，多用于理赔与客服，常见搭配 report a damaged parcel。

examples.en: I need to report a damaged parcel because the box was crushed and the contents were broken.
examples.zh: 我要申报一个破损件，因为箱子被压扁了，里面的东西也碎了。

examples.en: Please take photos of the damaged parcel and keep the tracking number for your claim.
examples.zh: 请给这个破损件拍照，并保留快递单号以便申请理赔。

entries.shortAnswer: 「纸箱」英文是 cardboard box，寄快递常用，口语也说 shipping box。
entries.definition: cardboard box 指硬纸板箱；快递搭配 pack in a cardboard box、a cardboard box arrives。

examples.en: Please put the books in a cardboard box and write the tracking number on the top.
examples.zh: 请把书放进纸箱，并在顶部写上快递单号。

examples.en: The courier left my cardboard box at the parcel locker because I was not at home.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的纸箱放在了快递柜，因为我不在家。

entries.shortAnswer: 纸箱 in English is cardboard box, the usual term for a shipping box.
entries.definition: cardboard box 是快递物流常用词，指纸板箱；搭配 pack in a cardboard box、a cardboard box arrives。

examples.en: Please put the books in a cardboard box and write the tracking number on the top.
examples.zh: 请把书放进纸箱，并在顶部写上快递单号。

examples.en: The courier left my cardboard box at the parcel locker because I was not at home.
examples.zh: 快递员把我的纸箱放在了快递柜，因为我不在家。

entries.shortAnswer: 「包装」的英文是 packaging，指包裹或商品的外包装材料与外观，在快递物流中常见，强调保护与美观。
entries.definition: packaging 多指商品或包裹的包装材料与外观，不可数。搭配有 packaging materials、eco-friendly packaging。注意：动词“打包”用 pack。

examples.en: The courier said the packaging was damaged, so I refused the delivery.
examples.zh: 快递员说包装破损了，所以我拒收了。

examples.en: Please keep the original packaging in case you need to return the item.
examples.zh: 请保留原包装，以备退货时需要。

entries.shortAnswer: packaging 的中文意思是「包装」，主要指包裹或商品的包装材料与外观，在快递物流中常见。
entries.definition: packaging 为不可数名词，指包装材料或方式，搭配有 shipping packaging、sustainable packaging。不要与 pack（打包动作）混淆。

examples.en: The courier said the packaging was damaged, so I refused the delivery.
examples.zh: 快递员说包装破损了，所以我拒收了。

examples.en: Please keep the original packaging in case you need to return the item.
examples.zh: 请保留原包装，以备退货时需要。

entries.shortAnswer: 「到付」的英文是 pay on delivery，即收件人收货时付款。注意 COD 多指货到付货款，到付运费更常说 freight collect。
entries.definition: 到付指运费或货款由收件人在签收时支付，中国电商和快递常见选项。英文 pay on delivery 通用；COD（cash on delivery）偏指货到付款的货款，freight collect 专指运费到付。

examples.en: The courier asked me to pay on delivery before handing over the parcel.
examples.zh: 快递员让我到付后才把包裹交给我。

examples.en: You can choose pay on delivery at checkout, but then you pay the shipping fee yourself.
examples.zh: 结算时你可以选择到付，但那样运费就得自己付。

entries.shortAnswer: Pay on delivery 的中文意思是「到付」，即收货时付款。它可指付货款或运费，但 COD 更偏货款，freight collect 专指运费到付。
entries.definition: pay on delivery 表示收货时付款，常见于电商结账和快递单。正式物流单据中，运费到付常用 freight collect；COD（cash on delivery）侧重货到付货款，口语中有时混用。

examples.en: The courier asked me to pay on delivery before handing over the parcel.
examples.zh: 快递员让我到付后才把包裹交给我。

examples.en: You can choose pay on delivery at checkout, but then you pay the shipping fee yourself.
examples.zh: 结算时你可以选择到付，但那样运费就得自己付。

entries.shortAnswer: 在快递物流中，「搬家」常用 moving house 表示；若仅寄包裹则说 shipping，不用 moving house。
entries.definition: moving house 指个人或家庭更换住所并搬运物品，英式常用，美式多说 moving。快递物流中涉及预约取件、打包、运费和保价。

examples.en: We're moving house next month, so I need to book a courier to transport all our boxes.
examples.zh: 我们下个月要搬家，所以我需要预约快递员来运送所有箱子。

examples.en: Moving house can be stressful, especially when you have to track multiple parcels and pay extra shipping fees.
examples.zh: 搬家可能压力很大，尤其是当你不得不跟踪多个包裹并支付额外运费的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「moving house」中文即「搬家」，强调家庭整体迁移；寄单个包裹用 shipping，而非 moving house。
entries.definition: moving house 是英式表达，美式常用 moving，中文译为「搬家」。快递物流中涉及预约取件、打包、运输、运费和保价。

examples.en: We're moving house next month, so I need to book a courier to transport all our boxes.
examples.zh: 我们下个月要搬家，所以我需要预约快递员来运送所有箱子。

examples.en: Moving house can be stressful, especially when you have to track multiple parcels and pay extra shipping fees.
examples.zh: 搬家可能压力很大，尤其是当你不得不跟踪多个包裹并支付额外运费的时候。

entries.shortAnswer: 「配送时间」的英文是 delivery time，指快递从发货到送达的时长，注意与 delivery date（送达日期）区分。
entries.definition: 常用搭配：estimated delivery time（预计配送时间）、shorten the delivery time（缩短配送时间）。delivery time 指时长，delivery date 指具体日期。

examples.en: The estimated delivery time for this parcel is three to five business days.
examples.zh: 这个包裹的预计配送时间是三到五个工作日。

examples.en: If you want to shorten the delivery time, choose express shipping at checkout.
examples.zh: 如果你想缩短配送时间，结账时请选择快递配送。

entries.shortAnswer: delivery time 的中文意思是「配送时间」，指快递从发出到送达所需的时间，强调时长而非日期。
entries.definition: 核心义为配送所需时长，常见搭配：estimated delivery time、shorten the delivery time。口语也说 shipping time，但更侧重运输环节。

examples.en: The estimated delivery time for this parcel is three to five business days.
examples.zh: 这个包裹的预计配送时间是三到五个工作日。

examples.en: If you want to shorten the delivery time, choose express shipping at checkout.
examples.zh: 如果你想缩短配送时间，结账时请选择快递配送。

entries.shortAnswer: 「搬家师傅」的英文是 mover，指搬家时负责搬运家具和重物的人，也可说 professional mover。
entries.definition: mover 指搬家时搬运家具、电器等重物的人，常搭配 professional mover、hire a mover；英式英语中也用 removal man。

examples.en: The movers arrived at eight in the morning and carefully carried the sofa down three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 搬家师傅早上八点就到了，小心翼翼地把沙发从三楼搬下来。

examples.en: We hired two movers to help us move the piano and other heavy furniture.
examples.zh: 我们雇了两个搬家师傅帮忙搬钢琴和其他重家具。

entries.shortAnswer: Mover 的中文意思是「搬家师傅」，即搬家时帮人搬运家具和重物的人，常说 professional mover。
entries.definition: A mover is a person hired to carry furniture and heavy items when moving home; common collocations are professional mover and hire a mover.

examples.en: The movers arrived at eight in the morning and carefully carried the sofa down three flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 搬家师傅早上八点就到了，小心翼翼地把沙发从三楼搬下来。

examples.en: We hired two movers to help us move the piano and other heavy furniture.
examples.zh: 我们雇了两个搬家师傅帮忙搬钢琴和其他重家具。

entries.shortAnswer: 「国际快递」的英文是 international courier，指跨国门到门递送服务。
entries.definition: international courier 强调专人上门收派，与侧重速度的 express 不同；常涉及清关和运费。

examples.en: I sent the documents to Tokyo by international courier and got a tracking number.
examples.zh: 我用国际快递把文件寄到东京，并拿到了快递单号。

examples.en: When the international courier arrived, I paid extra for customs clearance.
examples.zh: 国际快递员到达时，我额外支付了清关费用。

entries.shortAnswer: international courier 的中文是「国际快递」，指跨境专人递送服务。
entries.definition: international courier 指跨国包裹速递或快递员；常见搭配 send a parcel by international courier，注意与 carrier 区分。

examples.en: I sent the documents to Tokyo by international courier and got a tracking number.
examples.zh: 我用国际快递把文件寄到东京，并拿到了快递单号。

examples.en: When the international courier arrived, I paid extra for customs clearance.
examples.zh: 国际快递员到达时，我额外支付了清关费用。

entries.shortAnswer: 同城闪送的英文是 same-city courier，指同城即时专人配送，强调分钟级送达。
entries.definition: 同城闪送常用搭配：call a same-city courier、same-city courier service。别直译成 city flash delivery。

examples.en: I forgot my passport, so I called a same-city courier to bring it to the airport.
examples.zh: 我把护照忘了，于是叫了同城闪送送到机场。

examples.en: Same-city courier services are popular in China because they promise delivery in minutes.
examples.zh: 同城闪送服务在中国很流行，因为承诺几分钟送达。

entries.shortAnswer: Same-city courier is 同城闪送 in Chinese: fast intra-city delivery by a personal courier.
entries.definition: Same-city courier means an on-demand courier within one city, used for urgent items. In the US/UK, think bike messengers or DoorDash Drive.

examples.en: I forgot my passport, so I called a same-city courier to bring it to the airport.
examples.zh: 我把护照忘了，于是叫了同城闪送送到机场。

examples.en: Same-city courier services are popular in China because they promise delivery in minutes.
examples.zh: 同城闪送服务在中国很流行，因为承诺几分钟送达。

entries.shortAnswer: 物流信息的常用英文是 logistics status，但更泛指“物流信息”时用 logistics information，强调物流状态时用 logistics status。
entries.definition: 查询快递时，“物流信息”可指物流状态节点，也可指具体详情；logistics status 侧重运输进度，logistics information 侧重内容信息。

examples.en: I entered my tracking number to check the logistics status of my parcel.
examples.zh: 我输入快递单号来查询包裹的物流信息。

examples.en: The logistics status shows that my package is out for delivery and will arrive today.
examples.zh: 物流信息显示我的包裹正在派送中，今天会送到。

entries.shortAnswer: logistics status 的中文常译为“物流信息”或“物流状态”，但泛指物流信息时更常用 logistics information，强调状态时用 logistics status。
entries.definition: logistics status 指包裹运输中的状态更新，常搭配 check/track/update；logistics information 则指具体物流信息内容。

examples.en: I entered my tracking number to check the logistics status of my parcel.
examples.zh: 我输入快递单号来查询包裹的物流信息。

examples.en: The logistics status shows that my package is out for delivery and will arrive today.
examples.zh: 物流信息显示我的包裹正在派送中，今天会送到。

entries.shortAnswer: 「发货地」的英文是 shipping origin，常用于快递物流；别直译为 send goods place。
entries.definition: shipping origin 指包裹始发的地点，如仓库或商家地址；与收货地 shipping destination 相对。

examples.en: Please check the shipping origin on the label before you return the parcel.
examples.zh: 在退回包裹之前，请查看标签上的发货地。

examples.en: If the shipping origin is overseas, customs clearance may take a few extra days.
examples.zh: 如果发货地在海外，清关可能会多花几天时间。

entries.shortAnswer: shipping origin 的中文意思是「发货地」，即包裹或货物的发出地点，别与收货地混淆。
entries.definition: shipping origin 指物流中包裹的始发地点，常见于快递单、清关和退换货；与收货地相对。

examples.en: Please check the shipping origin on the label before you return the parcel.
examples.zh: 在退回包裹之前，请查看标签上的发货地。

examples.en: If the shipping origin is overseas, customs clearance may take a few extra days.
examples.zh: 如果发货地在海外，清关可能会多花几天时间。

entries.shortAnswer: 「快递员」的英文是 delivery courier，日常口语中也常说 delivery driver。delivery courier 更强调负责投递包裹或快件的人，常用于正式或书面表达。
entries.definition: delivery courier 指专门递送包裹、快件的配送人员。常见搭配有 act as a delivery courier、contact the delivery courier，注意与 courier company（快递公司）区分。

examples.en: The delivery courier dropped the parcel at my door and sent me a tracking number.
examples.zh: 快递员把包裹放在我家门口，并给我发了一个快递单号。

examples.en: If you miss the delivery courier, you can ask them to leave the package in a parcel locker.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了快递员，可以让他们把包裹放在快递柜里。

entries.shortAnswer: delivery courier 的中文意思是「快递员」。它比 delivery driver 更强调递送包裹/快件，偏正式；日常口语中 delivery driver 更常用。
entries.definition: delivery courier 指负责投递包裹或快件的快递员，常见于物流、电商语境。搭配如 contact the delivery courier、a delivery courier arrives。注意与 courier service（快递服务）区分。

examples.en: The delivery courier dropped the parcel at my door and sent me a tracking number.
examples.zh: 快递员把包裹放在我家门口，并给我发了一个快递单号。

examples.en: If you miss the delivery courier, you can ask them to leave the package in a parcel locker.
examples.zh: 如果你错过了快递员，可以让他们把包裹放在快递柜里。

entries.shortAnswer: 「清关」的英文是 customs clearance，指货物通过海关检查并办结手续。
entries.definition: 清关是快递物流的关键环节，指货物进出境时向海关申报并接受检查，办结手续后方可放行。常用搭配有 customs clearance process、complete customs clearance。

examples.en: Your parcel is still waiting for customs clearance, so the tracking number won't update until it's released.
examples.zh: 你的包裹仍在等待清关，所以快递单号在放行前不会更新。

examples.en: The delivery courier said the customs clearance fee must be paid before the parcel locker can release the item.
examples.zh: 快递员说必须先支付清关费，快递柜才能放行这件物品。

entries.shortAnswer: Customs clearance 的中文意思是「清关」，即货物进出境时向海关申报并接受检查的过程。
entries.definition: Customs clearance 指办结海关手续，常见搭配有 customs clearance agent、customs clearance fee、await customs clearance。口语也说 clear customs。

examples.en: Your parcel is still waiting for customs clearance, so the tracking number won't update until it's released.
examples.zh: 你的包裹仍在等待清关，所以快递单号在放行前不会更新。

examples.en: The delivery courier said the customs clearance fee must be paid before the parcel locker can release the item.
examples.zh: 快递员说必须先支付清关费，快递柜才能放行这件物品。

entries.shortAnswer: 「滞留件」英文常说 stranded parcel，指卡在物流环节、暂时无法继续派送的包裹。
entries.definition: stranded parcel 指因海关、地址或未取等原因卡在物流环节的包裹，仍可追踪，不等于丢件。

examples.en: My stranded parcel has been at the customs center for a week.
examples.zh: 我的滞留件已经在清关中心停了一周。

examples.en: Pick up your stranded parcel soon, or it will be returned.
examples.zh: 尽快取走你的滞留件，否则会被退回。

entries.shortAnswer: A stranded parcel is 滞留件, a package stuck in transit and not moving forward.
entries.definition: A stranded parcel is 滞留件, a shipment stuck in transit and still traceable.

examples.en: My stranded parcel has been at the customs center for a week.
examples.zh: 我的滞留件已经在清关中心停了一周。

examples.en: Pick up your stranded parcel soon, or it will be returned.
examples.zh: 尽快取走你的滞留件，否则会被退回。
